chapters.title: Chapter 851: Defeated
paragraphs: "What is she coming here for? I thought the Core Sect also has a Perfect Chamber," a disciple asked, but his friend immediately shut his mouth.
"If you value your life, then you must understand one rule: never question anything the Pill Princess does."
"This is crazy. First it was Kent, now the Pill Princess. Just how bad can the day get?"
"In the end, it is still the same rule: the strong trump the weak."
Many disciples were heartbroken when they saw the Pill Princess arrive at the Perfect Chamber.
However, while everyone expected her to walk toward the entrance, she merely stood 200 meters away, keeping her gaze fixed on the entrance of the Perfect Chamber.
This caused many disciples to start wondering what was going on. However, after a few minutes, they all returned to the topic at hand: Kent still had not come out of the Perfect Chamber.
Three hours later, Kent was utterly exhausted.
After the second phase of close combat, which took all he could muster, his body was ready to give up on him.
However, he knew he wouldn’t be walking out the same way he came. In fact, he knew things were much different now, and in a way, he was grateful.
But the battle wasn’t over.
He still had energy to use his skills and techniques.

First, he unleashed the Rapid Sword Move, creating 450 sword arcs, each coated in profound sword aura. He aimed to force the clone to focus more on the sword arcs while he used his sword moves on him.
As expected, the move was seen through by the clone, who, instead of defending using a skill, merely created a barrier using sword aura, deflecting all shards.
Kent, of course, went ahead with his second attack despite the outcome not looking good for him.
[Doom Shards]
Thick shards burst from the surface of the sword bridge, aiming to pierce the clone through the heart; however, the shards were met with a rather sleek use of the [Fractured Void] skill.
It was a rather smart way of using Kent’s own skill against him.
When he unleashed the Doom Shards, the clone opened a miniature version of Fractured Void, swallowing all the shards.
But it didn’t stop there—the clone went ahead and opened another void behind Kent, unleashing his own shard at him.
’Smart, but I saw that coming, Mr. Clone.’
Kent smirked and was about to raise his own barrier when a mind attack slammed into his mind, disturbing his thoughts.
’Shit’
That moment of distraction was all it took for the clone to do something that taught Kent a rather valuable lesson and perhaps a great attack combination he can use in the future.
Instead of all the shards coming straight at him, one swerved and came for his rib.
Kent, who failed to raise the shield barrier fully, had to deploy three clone bodies, which he immediately swapped places with, managing to keep his ribcage intact.
"That was close," Kent muttered, unleashing [Void Cleave].
However, the clone countered using the [Limitless Sword Arcs Domain].
The Limitless Sword Arcs deployed by the clone consumed the sword arc unleashed by the Void Cleave before it could even get within two meters of him.
But it didn’t stop there; instead, the Limitless Sword Arcs Domain expanded and caught hold of Kent. The moment he entered the domain, he felt his sword aura being cut and devoured by the shards.
’I am at a disadvantage even in the use of techniques,’ Kent sighed, but he didn’t give up just yet.
He started relying on his sword techniques and the flame arts.
He even went further, utilizing some of Jest’s skills, but after another hour—making it four hours since Kent entered the Perfect Chamber—he finally knew he was about to lose, and this time for good.
’I still don’t have the body to use the [One Slash Kill], so I suppose I will use the [Transcendent Heavenly Sword Technique] instead.’
Kent made his move, forming ten powerful swords in the air that quickly merged into one mighty sword.
The sword shot forward at a terrifying speed, one that could have caught most off guard. However, the clone slashed his sword, unleashing a powerful sword arc.
It was purple in color, and as it moved, it caused the space around it to start tearing.
It cleaved through the sword like it was mere paper.
But it didn’t stop with the sword.
It moved and cut Kent in half.
He wasn’t even able to dodge or block.
Kent didn’t black out or feel any pain. Instead, his body disintegrated, and then he was back standing at the place where he appeared the moment he entered the Perfect Chamber.
His body was yet again filled with energy like he hadn’t fought an intense four-hour battle with a perfect version of himself.
The clone, too, was gone.
"What was that?" Kent asked, not understanding how a single attack from a random sword move could handle the second form of the Transcendent Heavenly Sword Technique.
⟦First of all, the master shouldn’t panic. The attack used by your perfect clone was a perfect mastery of Void Cleave. The clone had fully mastered it.
However, as to why the Transcendent Heavenly Sword Technique was defeated, it was because the master’s mastery was only at the basic level.⟧
"I see. Then that means I still have a lot of things to do." Kent wasn’t disappointed. Instead, he saw another way to become even stronger now.
If learning a technique isn’t enough, then he will master every form to perfection if that is what it takes to reach his fullest potential in this Medium World.
"This has been very informative, but I would like to know my score before walking out."
⟦The master has scored 89%. Of course, with the Tower being only 95% perfect, the master is estimated to have already reached 84% of his true potential in a Medium world.⟧
"I suppose this will keep me afloat for now." Kent smiled and then started walking away from the Sword Bridge.
A second later, he appeared through the door to the sight of absolute silence, all eyes aimed at him.
To some degree, it was imposing; however, Kent merely smiled, knowing why they were all looking at him.
He even sensed a few powerful presences around, including Lady Enzi and Lady Liora. Old Sword was still in seclusion, but the other presences weren’t any weaker.
Even Kent could sense a rather powerful gaze coming from the distance, perhaps even several hundred miles away.
However, none of those gazes meant anything to him, for when his gaze met that of the Pill Princess, a smile formed on his lips.
’My work is never done,’ Kent said, knowing this was his chance to get what he wanted, while doing so would be helping the Pill Emperor also.
’Though, how should I go about it?’
Seeing the look in her eyes, Kent could tell she was shocked by his performance inside the Perfect Chamber.
Scoring 89% was already more than any disciple or elder had ever scored, so it was just too shocking for her to see the one person she came after make such progress.
This meant she had become weary, and even doing what she came there to do might be slipping from her mind. Kent is too monstrous, and she could see it now.
However, Kent also knew this was his chance.
After a few seconds of thinking, he smiled and raised his hand to quiet the murmurs.
"Those of you thinking I cheated to score 89%, know that without me, the sect wouldn’t win the upcoming Interplanetary Sect Competition."
And that was the trigger. Hearing Kent’s bold words, the flames of anger rekindled in the eyes of the Pill Princess.
"Tch, I would take those words back if I were you."

chapters.title: Chapter 852: The Duel
paragraphs: "Tch, I would take back those words if I were you."
The Pill Princess said, looking coldly at Kent.
As someone who prided herself on being stronger than everyone, she felt stung when Kent said those words. To her, this was Kent looking her in the face and spitting at her.

Kent, of course, was after that, for he knew undermining her was the fastest way to get what he wanted. Though he might earn more haters for taking this road, Kent didn’t care because he was after something important.
Every disciple became quiet, staring at Kent, who held a smile on his face.
"What if I don’t want to take back my words?" Kent replied, looking her in the eyes with a calm resolve. This only added to the bubbling anger simmering in the Pill Princess’s eyes.

"You may have received a slot to take part in the sect team selection thanks to Lady Enzi, but that doesn’t guarantee your win. If three of the seeded candidates were to refuse, then you would be taken off the team."
Of course, this was Kent’s first time hearing such a rule, but he wasn’t fazed.
"I guess if you all don’t see me as a worthy candidate, I will just challenge you all and beat the shit out of you, proving to the entire sect I am indeed better than you.
After all, the sect wants what is best for the sect. Knowing there is someone who can defeat the strongest of their team but isn’t part of their team, they wouldn’t hesitate to add me.
In this regard, you should just run back to wherever you came from, because today isn’t your day to get what you came for.
Of course, if you want to have another face-to-face with me, you can enter the Perfect Chamber and score 89% or higher. Then and only then would I recognize you as my equal."
With a smile on his face, Kent started walking away while the Pill Princess continued to bubble with anger.
’She should be reaching her breaking point by now.’
With the Enchanted Eyes, Kent knew all the best points to hit and how to go about it. He had delivered a rather good performance, and the outcome was about to show itself.
"If you are so confident in your abilities, then why don’t you accept a challenge from me and see if you will keep talking after?
Or do you think resisting a mere poison is enough to make you one of us?"
Kent paused in his step when he heard the Pill Princess’ words..
’This is the perfect moment for Lady Liora to appear,’ he said inwardly.
He turned and looked at the Pill Princess.

"Haven’t you any shame challenging a mere inner disciple? Or is that what you always do? You just come to the inner sect, challenge a bunch of inner disciples, and feel better about yourself, thinking you have made it?"
Kent flashed a mocking grin. "I never expected the almighty Pill Princess to be this shameless and low-class."
And with that nail hammered into the coffin, she snapped.
Kent felt a dense killing intent lock on him. The Pill Princess’s eyes ignited, unleashing a powerful internal energy.
The disciples around all ran back, feeling their bodies pressed down by the aura released from the Pill Princess.
Kent just raised his brow and was about to unleash his own aura when an ethereal beauty appeared out of thin air, causing the pressure in the air to vanish.

"Master... you are here." The Pill Princess spoke in a slight, panicked tone. Though she was still someone whom everyone hated due to her arrogance, when it came to her master, she seemed to still have some respect for her.
"You were supposed to be meditating, Sylvara. What are you doing here?" Lady Liora asked, pretending as if she hadn’t seen everything happen from the start.
Kent, who was watching her back, smiled inwardly, liking the acting side of the Pill Emperor.
"Master... I just... I—" The Pill Princess was out of words, looking dull at her master. Naturally, she had no good excuse for coming to the inner sect.
And while that was plain as day, she also had no idea her master would appear all of a sudden. This was a shock to her.
Lady Liora turned and looked at Kent, then she turned back to look at her disciple. "Two days from now, you two will fight in the Flame Master Arena.
If you win, Disciple Kent will become your servant for five years; if he wins, he will become a seeded candidate for the interplanetary Sect Competition.
Do any of you have any objections?"

Both Kent and the Pill Princess were left stunned, unsure of why the lady gave such stakes. Of course, Kent understood the motivation behind her words, but to think she wanted to take away the seed candidacy from her disciple was just wild.
"I don’t have any objections, master," the Pill Princess said, looking smugly at Kent.
Kent, on the other hand, just smiled. "I don’t plan on becoming some seeded candidate who will be displayed behind glass like a flower.
I like to do the work and get my efforts recognized, so instead of taking her spot as a seeded candidate when I win, how about she calls me Big Daddy Kent for three years instead?"
Even the disciples were left staring at Kent with shocked expressions. Rejecting a seeded slot just to request something this outrageous—it just doesn’t make any sense.
However, Kent had made his decision, and as someone who needed his services to discipline her disciple, Lady Liora accepted his ridiculous request.
"In that case, two days from today, Disciple Kent and the Pill Princess will have a duel at the Flame Master Arena. All disciples who would want to observe the battle should be seated before 9 a.m."
With that, Lady Liora left. Kent could swear he saw a smile on her face as she turned to leave. Once she was gone, Kent turned to the Pill Princess and smiled.
"Tell me, Pill Princess, do you know what karma is?"
The Pill Princess frowned, unsure where Kent was going with this. Kent just smiled and continued his words.
"Karma is when you either get a good outcome of your deeds or a bad one.
You have always been arrogant and disrespectful, thinking of yourself as better than everyone, when in fact, you are not even close to being better than anyone in this world.
Of course, because you are arrogant, you failed to see past your arrogance, and that was your mistake this time, young lady.

You see, if you had looked past your arrogance, you would have researched me, and that’s when you would have found out that three years ago, I was merely a Root Awakening stage cultivator, but in just three years, I have reached the Core Formation stage.
If you had researched me, you would have found out I scared shit out of the ancestor of the Elven race, your Grandma, causing her to run back into hiding with just my words.
But because you didn’t, two days from today, I am going to wreck you. I will discipline you to the point that the next time you see me, you will run and hide.
Be happy that I am not allowed to kill you...permanently. But even so, you are going to wish I kill you."
Kent smiled and then flew away, leaving the Pill Princess in stunned silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 853: Strange Behaviour, Day of the Duel
paragraphs: [Lady Enzi’s Floating Island- Supreme Immortal Sect]
"Was offering your disciples seeded candidacy spot as the wager really necessary?" Lady Enzi asked, looking at Lady Liora with a strange expression.
She was already aware of the arrangement between Kent and her, so she wasn’t surprised when Lady Liora made the duel official.
The only thing she didn’t expect was Lady Liora putting the Pill Princess’s seeded candidacy at stake by using it as a wager in the duel.
It was one of the many things every core disciple would kill for, so for her to use it so casually was something she never expected.

"I wanted her to feel what it was like to have something precious taken from her. Since the day I took her in as my disciple, I have given her everything she needed, in the hope that she would use it to become the best version of herself.
But I suppose that didn’t work out well in the end, so I wanted to try something new."
"But was offering her a seeded spot really the best way to go about it? It doesn’t sound like you, Liora. It felt almost like a different side of you had taken over. A much darker side of you."
Lady Liora was a little surprised to hear what Lady Enzi said. She was stunned to hear she had become somebody different to the point that the aloof glass lady even noticed.
The true her wouldn’t go that far—offering something that’s dear to her disciple’s heart casually to others.
"I guess I had had enough of her behavior, and while I kept convincing myself it would be all right, that she would change, I also started to lose track of myself."
Lady Enzi just sighed. "Maybe I should handle things from here onward. You have done enough, and it will be best if you don’t get involved anymore."
"Are you sure?"

"I don’t have anything to do for the next few days, so I will handle the events from here onward. Use the time to handle your affairs and get a hold of yourself before you ruin yourself and your disciple."
"Thank you."
"Don’t worry about it."
Lady Liora soon went back to her dwelling to handle her inner demons, while Lady Enzi would be taking events into her own hands from here onward.
As a good friend, Lady Enzi knew her friend was not feeling like herself, so she planned to sacrifice her time to ensure she got some rest.
If she were to get worse before she realized it, then the damage would already be done.
[Core Sect - Supreme Immortal Sect]
Words of Kent, scoring 89% in the Perfect Chamber, have reached every last disciple, hitting them hard like a hammer.
They never expected the same Kent, whose name is on everyone’s lips, to have done something huge again that everyone couldn’t keep quiet about.
However, the first news was soon overshadowed by the second, which hit even harder.
"I can’t believe an Inner Disciple will be having an official duel with a core disciple—and not just any core disciple, but the Pill Princess of all people.
Does this Kent perhaps have a death wish?"
"What else do you expect? Just because he managed to withstand the poison from Big Brother Xhan, he thinks he can now take on every seeded candidate."
"It’s just too bad this is not a death match. I would love to see his burnt corpse when the Pill Princess is done with him."

Naturally, every disciple was looking forward to Kent’s defeat, considering he had not only declared he was better than everyone, but he also made sure his words were directed at all five seeded candidates.
[Two days later – Flame Master Arena]
The day of the duel between Kent and the Pill Princess had arrived, and at the moment, the Flame Master Arena, a special arena located at Flame Peak, was filled to the brim.
It was an arena designed for disciples who cultivate the flame element. It restricts all other skills and allows only flame-type skills to be used.
This means the battle, as Lady Liora discussed with Kent, would be flame-based.
Both core and inner disciples were currently seated, each anticipating the upcoming battle.

Then there was the One-Eyed Demon Spawn, who wished this battle were between him and Kent.
Just as every last disciple became angry upon hearing Kent’s bold words after he came out of the Perfect Chamber, he too became furious and wanted to teach Kent a lesson.
However, the one most furious was the arrogant Crystal Dragon Prince, who prided himself on being better than everyone.
Right now, the only thing preventing him from running onto the stage and facing Kent instead was Lady Enzi, who hovered over the stage, ready to officiate the duel.
The first to appear on stage was the Pill Princess, clad in sleek, red leather armor, designed with style and purpose.
It highlighted her beauty.
Though her arrogance was rather something dislikable about her, she had fans, and they all started cheering as she walked gracefully into the arena and onto the stage.
She stood on her side of the stage, holding her sword firmly, ready to handle the brat who dared accept a duel against her.

Naturally, the arrogance was clear, and this only made the Pill Princess even more pissed off.
"Looks like you couldn’t wait long enough to lose, so you came early," Kent said, smiling at the Pill Princess.
The princess looked at him for a few seconds and pointed her sword at him. "You should do your best because becoming my servant isn’t something you want."

"Oh, I most certainly wouldn’t want to find out the hard way, I guess. But the same goes for you—calling me Big Daddy Kent for three years will be hell and humiliating, so do well to beat me, for that is the only way out for you."
The comments were cut short, and the main battle was about to begin.
"Remember, you can choose to tap out or die and respawn on the outside. Aside from that, the moment your opponent surrenders, the battle is over.

"No."
Both Kent and the Pill Princess said in unison.
"In that case, you may begin."
The Pill Princess dashed toward Kent, her sword lit with blue flames.
Kent smiled and bit into his apple, taking a bite.

"Was offering your disciples seeded candidacy spot as the wager really necessary?" Lady Enzi asked, looking at Lady Liora with a strange expression.

The only thing she didn’t expect was Lady Liora putting the Pill Princess’s seeded candidacy at stake by using it as a wager in the duel.
It was one of the many things every core disciple would kill for, so for her to use it so casually was something she never expected.
"I wanted her to feel what it was like to have something precious taken from her.

"But was offering her a seeded spot really the best way to go about it?

It felt almost like a different side of you had taken over.
A much darker side of you."
Lady Liora was a little surprised to hear what Lady Enzi said.

The true her wouldn’t go that far—offering something that’s dear to her disciple’s heart casually to others.
"I guess I had had enough of her behavior, and while I kept convincing myself it would be all right, that she would change, I also started to lose track of myself."
Lady Enzi just sighed.
"Maybe I should handle things from here onward.
You have done enough, and it will be best if you don’t get involved anymore."
"Are you sure?"
"I don’t have anything to do for the next few days, so I will handle the events from here onward.
Use the time to handle your affairs and get a hold of yourself before you ruin yourself and your disciple."
"Thank you."
"Don’t worry about it."
Lady Liora soon went back to her dwelling to handle her inner demons, while Lady Enzi would be taking events into her own hands from here onward.
As a good friend, Lady Enzi knew her friend was not feeling like herself, so she planned to sacrifice her time to ensure she got some rest.
If she were to get worse before she realized it, then the damage would already be done.

"What else do you expect?

chapters.title: Chapter 854: Diamond Body
paragraphs: The Pill Princess wanted to end the battle quickly, so the Moment Lady Enzi gave the command to start, she moved, her sword lit with blue flames.
The distance between her and Kent was just twenty meters, so crossing it at her speed wasn’t that hard. She moved and arrived before Kent in no time at all.
However, instead of taking out his sword to defend himself, Kent merely took a fresh apple and bit into it.
The Pill Princess didn’t mind his provocation and instead stabbed her sword at his chest, planning to end the battle instantly.
However, when the sword touched Kent’s body, it came to a stop, leaving a rather unexpected sound in the air.
"Clang."
It sounded like metal striking metal.
Kent let a grin appear on his lips, but the next second, the Pill Princess attacked again, this time with a sweeping strike aimed at Kent’s neck.
It was a powerful swing.
However, again, like the stabbing attack, her sword met solid metal, creating only a clang sound.

She attacked five more times, aiming for a few other places on Kent’s body, but every time, it was like she was striking a metal dummy—one that didn’t even show any signs of pain when her attacks landed on him.
"Looks like you are having a performance issue, Princess. Are you perhaps too weak to even cut my skin?" Kent said, then took another chunk off the apple in his hands.
The frown on the Pill Princess’s face deepened as she distanced herself from Kent and unleashed a vertical slash with her sword, causing a large fireball to appear in the air.
"Incinerating fireball."
The fireball shot at Kent as she spoke, aiming to incinerate him. However, Kent merely stood there watching as the fireball landed on his body, creating a powerful explosion.
The flames consumed him, causing many to gasp, with a few hoping Kent would respawn on the outside.
However, that didn’t happen; instead, he remained standing inside the stage with his shirt burnt, revealing a rather striking physique, one that caught everyone off guard.
Kent just smiled, looking at the Pill Princess.

"Your attack wasn’t weak, if that was what you were thinking. It is just that the current you isn’t qualified to injure me. No matter how hard you try, you wouldn’t be able to land even a cut on my body."
Kent walked forward, making sure the Pill Princess was in his sight. "Do you want to know the why?"
In response, the Pill Princess formed a hand seal, conjuring a bird made of flames. It rose into the air and dived headfirst toward Kent.
The space around Kent immediately heated up.
However, aside from merely smiling, nothing else changed.
He allowed the flame to bathe him.
After a few seconds, his body was revealed, perfect and intact.
The attack, intended to harm him, clearly failed to achieve its goal.
Instead, Kent merely walked out of the flame looking like a fire demon.
"Tickles," Kent laughed and stood there, smugly looking at the Pill Princess.
"How?" she asked, her expression shocked as she looked at Kent.
The [Flaming Bird] skill was one of her best, so to think she couldn’t even make a dent on Kent’s body left her in shock.
And she wasn’t the only one in shock.
All over the arena, every last disciple was just seated, staring at Kent like he was some demon.

None understood how the battle they all assumed would be over in minutes had turned into one-sided dominance. The worst part was that the Pill Princess, who was being dominated, was the one doing the attacking.
It all just didn’t make sense.
"Listen carefully, Princess, for I am going to say this one time. The reason I see you as a nobody is that, aside from your status as the Pill Princess, you are basically a nobody.
You may be regarded as a talented cultivator in this sect, but in the grand scheme of things, you are but a mere toad in a rather large river.
I am a mere 21-year-old handsome human who started cultivating three years ago; however, within those three years, I managed to achieve what takes others thousands of years to do.
First, let’s discuss your strongest suit: alchemy. I asked around, and I was told you are really talented and that you are a one-in-a-million talent.
I do not doubt that. However, can you boldly say you were able to rise from a nobody to a mere Pill Grandmaster capable of concocting Tier 8 perfect pills within three years of starting alchemy?
Can you beat your chest and say you attained both Flame Comprehension and Resistance in under three years? That you unlocked Profound Sword Intent and Aura in under three years?
If that isn’t enough, do you know anyone who has awakened both Sword Gaze and Sword Body in under three years of wielding the sword?
Even worse, how about achieving Diamond Body cultivation in under three years?
Now, if that is not enough, you can add the part where I managed to comprehend twelve divine-grade flame arts in under an hour.
Basically, I am better than you in every way. Though I must say, perhaps you can beat me in alchemy because, unlike you, I don’t have a fantastic master to aid me.
But aside from that, can you see the gap between us?
I don’t like to brag, but why not this one time?
I can beat my chest and swear with absolute certainty that, aside from me, nobody has been able to merge their body cultivation with their true physique. And yes, I also possess a true physique.
I am one of a kind, and because of this, even if you were to strike my body thousands of times, you wouldn’t be able to leave a cut on my skin.
Unless you can use Heavenly Sword Aura, defeating a diamond body is not something you can do.

So, my dear Pill Princess, I will give you some good advice today: instead of looking down on people, look for the qualities in them, and perhaps you will be shocked to know they have something worth learning."
Kent looked toward the VIP room housing the four seeded candidates and smiled at them before turning back to the Pill Princess, who looked like she was having a reality check.
"You know, I thought hard about how I was going to wreck and dismantle you. However, after a deep inner search, I couldn’t bring myself to torture you, so you can go ahead and surrender.
And don’t worry, you don’t have to call me Big Daddy Kent."
The entire arena was quiet, nobody saying anything after Kent ended his speech.
Whether it was the disciples, the elders, or a few hidden ones, every one of them was left stunned, unsure of how to process any of this.
It was like the way they all saw cultivation had been turned upside down by Kent, and that alone rendered them shocked beyond their imagination.
The Pill Princess stood rooted in the same spot with her sword still in her hands, unsure of what to do. Accepting defeat wasn’t something she planned on doing today.
But as it stood, that was all she could do.
However, before she could make the decision, the space cracked, and a man with a pair of dragon horns on his forehead stepped out, locking his gaze on Kent.

chapters.title: Chapter 855: Sect Leader
paragraphs: "Greetings, sect leader." Everyone went down on their knees the moment the dragon man appeared.
He was the sect leader of the Supreme Immortal Sect and the second strongest in the Celestial Conclave Planetary Alliance: Sect Leader Deimos.
He looked at Kent as if trying to see through him; however, after a few seconds, he sighed and turned toward the Pill Princess.
"Greetings, sect leader," she bowed further, still on her knees.
Inside the arena, the only person still standing upright was Kent. Even Lady Enzi had her head bowed, as did all the other elders around.
Sect Leader Deimos looked at the Pill Princess for a few seconds before turning back to Kent.
"Little brother, what is your name?" he asked with a smile.
Kent smiled back and answered, "Kent."
"Well, Kent, you can call me Deimos."

"A good name for a handsome dragon," Kent said, causing the smile on the sect leader’s face to bloom. He ignored everyone else and focused solely on Kent. After all, he was the reason why he came out of seclusion.
"I heard all you said, little brother, and I have to say, I am impressed. Though I have just one question, if you don’t mind."
"You can ask, sect leader."
"Is that an Ambrosia Apple you are eating?" Sect Leader Deimos asked, and Kent smiled.
"It’s indeed an Ambrosia Apple." Kent took out a fresh Ambrosia Apple and threw it at the sect leader, who caught it firmly in his grip.
"This is..." A shocked look appeared on his face when he sensed the grade of the apple.
This sight caused everyone to start wondering just what grade of Ambrosia Apple Kent had given to the sect leader to cause such a reaction.
They all looked at Kent, but none could ask him what had happened. In the end, the sect leader looked at Kent and smiled.
"When you are free, come to the core sect. I have something to discuss with you."
Kent nodded.
"In that case, the duel is over; you can all go back to your cultivation."
With that, everything came to an end, and nobody could understand how a battle that was meant to be a good one ended so abruptly, with many events making absolutely no sense.
Kent went back to the floating island where Lady Enzi was waiting for him with many questions on her mind.
Naturally, Kent planned on answering them all.
[Inner Sect – Inside the Immortal Cave of the Sect Leader]
The moment the sect leader returned to his dwelling, he sat down in a lotus posture. Then, with a trembling hand, he took out the immortal-grade Ambrosia apple that Kent had given him.
His hands, which had firmly caught the apples when Kent threw them, were now shaking as sweat broke out on his forehead, unsure of what to think.
"Just how?" he muttered, looking at the fruit.
During the duel, he had been observing Kent from a distance, just like he had been doing from the very moment Kent stepped into the sect.
He was informed of a rare genius who had mastered twelve divine-grade flame arts, and so, for the past few months since Kent joined the sect, he had been observing him.
However, during the duel, he sensed something unusual about the apple Kent was eating, so he decided to check it out.

But who would have thought he would find himself now in possession of Ambrosia apples—and it wasn’t just an ordinary one like the ones he had eaten in the past. This was an immortal-grade Ambrosia apple.
"With this, I will be able to break more limits and ascend in a few years," he smiled slightly, then sat properly.
He could not wait any longer. Not when he has an immortal grade apple in his hand.
With just two bites, he consumed the apple, feeling the energy surge into his body.
[Core Sect – Pill Princess’s POV]
The Pill Princess, after her defeat, left the Flame Master Arena with a lot of thinking to do.
First, she saw what true talent looks like, and that alone was enough for her to see the error of her ways.
However, while she was panicking inside that her defeat would be accompanied by her calling Kent all those ridiculous names, she was relieved when Kent said she was free to go.
This prompted her to conduct a deep soul search and ask herself if she would have been able to allow Kent to go if she had won the duel.
The answer to that was no, and that answer was what finally gave her the resolution to all her questions.
She finally realized that in her bid to become the best, she had lost sight of what she truly wanted, which was to become the best alchemist there is.
She, at one point, wanted only to make pills and help the needy, but after fame got to her, she lost sight of what she stood for. It only got worse when she became the disciple of the Pill Emperor.
Now, she can see she had done more damage in the years she spent making sure everybody knew she was the best, and now that Kent had opened her eyes, the regret finally set in.
At the moment, she was cooped up in her immortal cave shedding bitter tears, unsure of what to do, how to make amends, or even if she was worthy of coming back to the real her ever again.
She had spent years believing she was the best when, in fact, aside from alchemy, she wasn’t much.
The Ice Maiden and the other seeded candidates had long surpassed her, and now, after failing even to make Kent move back with any of her attacks, she finally realized that.
For the next couple of days, she would shed her tears, but once she returned to the path she was meant to walk, her future would indeed be limitless, as she had been told many years ago.
Meanwhile, the other four seeded candidates, after the duel, also returned to their immortal caves; however, instead of lazing around, they all went back to work.

They had just seen what Kent could do, and while they would love to gloat—especially the Crystal Dragon Prince—and say they were the best and superior to everyone else, the outcome had already given them the reality check they so desperately needed.
They are powerful, but compared to Kent, they aren’t much.
But it wasn’t just them.
Almost every disciple who saw the battle had a change of heart, and so they all went back to training, aiming to at least rise to the level Kent is at at the moment.
[Core of the Universe – Lady Universe’s POV]
It had been a while since Lady Universe sat down to watch Kent.
After the events that nearly made her cry, she took a couple of days off.
However, now she was back, and while she was happy to see Kent dominate the sect and make everyone look like a joke, her smile was short-lived.

The repercussions that followed the events that put Gaia and her sisters in a deep sleep were now bubbling up, and as such, she could only hope the one at the receiving end would be able to handle it.
’I hope you are ready, Chaos; your life is about to take a sharp turn.’

Naturally, Kent planned on answering them all.
[Inner Sect – Inside the Immortal Cave of the Sect Leader]
The moment the sect leader returned to his dwelling, he sat down in a lotus posture.
Then, with a trembling hand, he took out the immortal-grade Ambrosia apple that Kent had given him.
His hands, which had firmly caught the apples when Kent threw them, were now shaking as sweat broke out on his forehead, unsure of what to think.
"Just how?" he muttered, looking at the fruit.
During the duel, he had been observing Kent from a distance, just like he had been doing from the very moment Kent stepped into the sect.
He was informed of a rare genius who had mastered twelve divine-grade flame arts, and so, for the past few months since Kent joined the sect, he had been observing him.
However, during the duel, he sensed something unusual about the apple Kent was eating, so he decided to check it out.
But who would have thought he would find himself now in possession of Ambrosia apples—and it wasn’t just an ordinary one like the ones he had eaten in the past.
This was an immortal-grade Ambrosia apple.
"With this, I will be able to break more limits and ascend in a few years," he smiled slightly, then sat properly.
He could not wait any longer.
Not when he has an immortal grade apple in his hand.
With just two bites, he consumed the apple, feeling the energy surge into his body.
[Core Sect – Pill Princess’s POV]
The Pill Princess, after her defeat, left the Flame Master Arena with a lot of thinking to do.
First, she saw what true talent looks like, and that alone was enough for her to see the error of her ways.
However, while she was panicking inside that her defeat would be accompanied by her calling Kent all those ridiculous names, she was relieved when Kent said she was free to go.
This prompted her to conduct a deep soul search and ask herself if she would have been able to allow Kent to go if she had won the duel.
The answer to that was no, and that answer was what finally gave her the resolution to all her questions.
She finally realized that in her bid to become the best, she had lost sight of what she truly wanted, which was to become the best alchemist there is.
She, at one point, wanted only to make pills and help the needy, but after fame got to her, she lost sight of what she stood for.
It only got worse when she became the disciple of the Pill Emperor.
Now, she can see she had done more damage in the years she spent making sure everybody knew she was the best, and now that Kent had opened her eyes, the regret finally set in.
At the moment, she was cooped up in her immortal cave shedding bitter tears, unsure of what to do, how to make amends, or even if she was worthy of coming back to the real her ever again.
She had spent years believing she was the best when, in fact, aside from alchemy, she wasn’t much.
The Ice Maiden and the other seeded candidates had long surpassed her, and now, after failing even to make Kent move back with any of her attacks, she finally realized that.
For the next couple of days, she would shed her tears, but once she returned to the path she was meant to walk, her future would indeed be limitless, as she had been told many years ago.
Meanwhile, the other four seeded candidates, after the duel, also returned to their immortal caves; however, instead of lazing around, they all went back to work.

They had just seen what Kent could do, and while they would love to gloat—especially the Crystal Dragon Prince—and say they were the best and superior to everyone else, the outcome had already given them the reality check they so desperately needed.
They are powerful, but compared to Kent, they aren’t much.
But it wasn’t just them.
Almost every disciple who saw the battle had a change of heart, and so they all went back to training, aiming to at least rise to the level Kent is at at the moment.
[Core of the Universe – Lady Universe’s POV]
It had been a while since Lady Universe sat down to watch Kent.
After the events that nearly made her cry, she took a couple of days off.
However, now she was back, and while she was happy to see Kent dominate the sect and make everyone look like a joke, her smile was short-lived.

The repercussions that followed the events that put Gaia and her sisters in a deep sleep were now bubbling up, and as such, she could only hope the one at the receiving end would be able to handle it.
’I hope you are ready, Chaos; your life is about to take a sharp turn.’

chapters.title: Chapter 856: Vacation Is Over
paragraphs: [Four Months After the Duel - Lady Enzi’s Dwelling]
It had already been four months since the duel between Kent and the Pill Princess.
A lot had happened ever since then. Things Kent never expected to happen had occurred, and the outcome was just too crazy.
First of all, Old Sword came out of seclusion, became sworn brothers with Kent, and declared that he would be ascending to a High world in the next three months.
This news shook the entire sect and even found its way to the other worlds, causing some of the Sword Emperors in the Alliance to come to the sect and hear it from Old Sword himself.
Of course, most came with the intention to measure their strength against him. However, after they all got a taste of the terror that Old Sword had become, they wiped the idea from their minds.
As someone who had already reached the 5th level of the Heavenly Sword Energy (Aura/Intent) stage, nobody below the Sword Monarch stage could win a sword battle against him.
In fact, he had become so powerful that going to a ’Great’ High World would not be an issue.
All this, of course, was thanks to Kent.
He took Kent to his world, where, thanks to Kent’s subtle suggestions, he made his pupil take Kent in as their guardian.
Of course, the brat was more than happy to yet again add a world of 3.4 billion people to his guardian tower, turning all of them into his Soul Essence generators.
But while Old Sword was away preparing for his ascension, Kent’s relationship with Lady Enzi had also taken a huge leap.
After the duel, she confronted Kent about what happened between him and the Sect Leader.
Kent told her everything she wanted to know, and after it all, he offered her more fruits that she could eat.
Since then, their relationship has started to improve,
Lady Enzi became more easygoing, and Kent, who wanted a big sister so badly, started treating her as one.
First, he took her into the Tower, where he showed her the city and the amazing things he wanted her to see. In return, she also took him to her world, a small yet beautiful one.
Just like with Elder Lance, she was also treated as the supreme protector of their world until Kent became their guardian.
To his shock, this small world had three allies, each a much bigger world.

Kent, being a lucky bastard, triggered the [Guardian Allies] ability with all three, so his Asteroid project has become as big as the Titanic, and that alone is more than enough for him to miss the Weapon Refining competition.
Of course, thanks to Lady Enzi, he managed to acquire not less than a dozen refined swords, which he took into his soul universe and started turning them into deadly weapons.
As for Lady Liora, she had finally gotten back the disciple she had always wanted, and the joy in that was more than enough for her to come and thank Kent more than five times.
In fact, just like with Lady Enzi, their relationship had also leaped, but not as high as with Lady Enzi.
Even so, she also received Kent’s generosity.
In the end, she, in a way, opened up to Kent about her origin.
It turned out she was from a High World that was already nearing the ranks of a Supreme High World, making her a rather dangerous person to be roaming a medium world.
Of course, Kent understood when she said nothing about her assassin side. But Kent also did not ask her about it.
He knew that some things were better left unsaid.
He also did not want to explain how he had come to know all about her past when she clearly hadn’t said anything to him.
But they had fun, and that was what mattered.
The sect master was now deep in cultivation, so Kent did not bother him. He knew he would be out in five months, since that was when the interplanetary competition would begin.
Kent had also managed to raise his cultivation base to Level 8, just one level away from forming his core.
However, he did not need that yet, as he had other things to attend to.
The last person Kent bonded with was Nyss, who had become something akin to his junior sister despite being several years older than him.
She had been training very seriously, aiming to defeat her brother one of these days, so aside from a few hours outside just to check up on Kent, she was basically indoors cultivating.
Kent chose to help her, despite her not having a world he could become guardian of, to farm soul essence.
She even received an invitation to participate in the sect team selection, but she turned it down, saying she was not needed if someone like Kent, her big brother, was already a member.
In the end, Kent just wanted to see her happy.
"AaaaaaHHH!"

Camilla moaned, her body drenched in sweat as Kent shot his load deep inside her. Her body became incredibly sensitive, causing every gentle movement of Kent’s fingers to incite thrilling reactions from her.
Just as many things had happened over the past four months, Camilla was also one of the many things.
She finally woke up.
Kent, who had been waiting for her to wake all this while, was more than happy to welcome her with whatever she wanted.

Thus, inside Camilla’s Dawn Space, they had been spending the last two weeks in each other’s arms while the rest of her sisters returned to the third floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon and started exploring the now-damaged unbreakable city.
Kent was just happy Camilla was now back.
After two more weeks together, they finally returned to the tower, where Kent planned on finally parting ways with Camilla.
"Are you sure you’re ready to get back out there?" Kent asked, looking fondly at Camilla.
"I’m fine, Kent. It was just a backlash from the attack, but thanks to Big Sister Vexthra, I’m more than healed." Camilla smiled and kissed Kent, assuring him she was fine.
"Just don’t overwork yourself. You can always return to the tower to rest if you want."
"I will. But don’t worry, I’m fine."
Kent nodded, and after a few more kisses, he let her go.

Gaia and her sisters were still not yet up, so Kent merely went to check up on them, and after a few minutes, he went back to the sword tower to finally use the Memory Key in his possession to unlock more of his memories.
Next time, he planned on challenging the Perfect Chamber with no less than a 95% win rate, so he sought to use all the assets in his possession to get what he wanted.

"I’ve already done all there is to do inside the sect, and with Big Sister Enzi willing to cover for me after bribing her with more treasures, I can finally get back to my training," Kent laughed. "That shameless sister of mine."
He shook his head and was about to sit down when a certain danger warning signal appeared before his vision.
Then, without even knowing when it happened, he vanished and appeared in a completely different place.
BOOM!
Suddenly, a powerful explosion rocked the forest several miles from him, but the shockwave was enough to push him back.
Then he saw it.
He saw the reason why he was there...
⟦Urgent Quest: Rescue the Virgin Succubus. Failure Means Death⟧

chapters.title: Chapter 857: Deadly Quest
paragraphs: [24 Hours Before The Deadly Quest - Planet Bacchus - Dream Garden]
Inside a lush garden, one without a single flaw, sat Adina, a rather beautiful lady, one who could rival goddesses and Celestials.
She exuded an aura of calm and happiness.
Of course, being inside the Dream Garden would make anyone happy. On Planet Bacchus, it was regarded as one of the most beautiful and peaceful places to be.
Adina had been living there for years.
However, she knew it was only a matter of time before her peaceful days came to an end.

She set the scroll she was reading aside and walked out of the garden, entering a wooden house. She went to the bath and, after confirming nobody was around, took off her disguise, revealing her true self.
She was a succubus who, regardless of how one might see it, had no hunger for sex in her eyes. To her, living long enough to become an immortal was all she ever wanted.
However, before she could even finish bathing, she sensed a presence appear outside.
"Big sister Adina, you have to leave now."
The person spoke in a hasty tone before vanishing back into the chaos that had appeared in the Dream Garden.
Adina put on her disguise, which only concealed her horns and cheery lips.
"I knew this day would come," she muttered, fearing that if she waited to take anything, she would run out of time.
She didn’t.
Instead, she vanished from her house and appeared on the other side of the garden.
The moment she appeared, a woman appeared beside her. "I am sorry, young miss, but you have to leave."
The woman, a level 4 Spirit Lord, spoke and then retrieved a token from her space ring and handed it over to Adina.
"It is the teleportation key to Planet Mekyn. I have managed to form a connection with the High Priestess there, so she will be waiting for you upon your arrival.
I will find my way to you. For now, go through the Valley of Torture; it will take you to the Teleportation Mountains. Use the key to activate it, and it will take you to Planet Mekyn."
Adina received the token and, with tears in her eyes, hugged the woman.
"Come back to me safely, sister," Adina said before stepping away.
The woman smiled. "I will. For now, go."
Adina nodded, wiped her tears, and ran off. The moment she was gone, the lady also wiped a tear from her eyes before taking a pill from her space ring and swallowing it.
A few seconds later, she transformed into a carbon copy of Adina and moved toward the attack happening between the invaders and the guards of the Dream Light Temple.
[24 Hours Before The Deadly Quest - Planet Menelaus - Red Devils Mercenary]
"Team Leader, are we taking on this mission?" a man with a rough face tattoo asked, holding a scroll in his hand.
He looked like a human, but he was a breed of demon, one that appeared as if his face had been tattooed with a hot knife.
"This is a huge mission, Iver. We cannot just ignore it," a Dark Elf replied, looking skeptical, though he didn’t want to let go of such a mission.
"But do we really want to work with the Wandering Demon Swordsman? Team leader, I don’t think this is a good mission right after we closed the last mission with a clean slate."

"Relax, Iver. We just have to cross the path of someone at the Valley of Torture, capture her alive or dead, and deliver her to the one who gave us the mission. Having the Wandering Demon Swordsman with us is even better.
Plus, I have already received word that over ten other mercenary guilds have received this offer. Turning it down will paint a bad image for our organization."
Iver wanted to say more, but looking at the team leader, he knew his words would fall on deaf ears, so he said nothing and just walked away.
He was the vice leader of the Red Devils mercenary group. They were one of the best in their world, and at the moment, the mission they were hired to handle was one he saw as no easy task.

For someone to be willing to pay 100 billion Spirit Stones to hire their services to capture or kill a level 3 Spirit Lord made Iver wary, and that wariness was something he had been feeling for a long time now.
However, with the money on the line and many hungry demons willing to do anything to earn a living, he could only support his team with whatever his level 5 Spirit Lord cultivation could do for him.
[Present Day - Valley Of Torture - Kent’s POV]
Kent was about to dive back into his cultivation when he was pulled to an unknown place. The moment he appeared, he heard a powerful explosion, one that sent a shockwave everywhere.
He felt it, and that was when he knew where he had appeared.
"This is a High World." He felt a chill run down his back, but he moved, flying toward the explosion.
He used the time to check the quest he had received.
⟦Urgent Quest: Rescue the Virgin Succubus. Failure Means Death⟧
⟦Description: Adina, the Sin of Lust, is in dire need of rescue after her location was leaked. You are required to rescue her and send her to the Teleportation Mountains.
Failure to ensure her successful rescue means death.
The Tower Space is locked and can only be accessed after the mission.
Upon completion of the mission, your rewards will be released.
Good luck⟧
"This is crazy," Kent muttered and called out to the tower.
⟦The Master can’t summon anyone or send anyone into the tower. But I am available to aid the master as much as I can.⟧
Kent understood right away that this mission wasn’t from the tower, but all he could do was continue flying toward the location from which more explosions were coming.
Every second he spent flying, he could only hope to get there faster.
Eventually, he approached the location where the battle was taking place.
The first thing he saw was the back of a lady whose body was littered with cuts, yet she stood firm, parrying, defending, and doing her best to find an opening and run.
Kent didn’t need anyone to tell him she was the lady he was there to rescue.
Ambushing her was a group of masked individuals.
"Three Spirit Lords and thirteen Spirit Sovereigns," Kent came to a halt.
The odds he saw weren’t what he was hoping for. However, with the lady’s life at stake and now connected to his, he had to act.
So, without even thinking, Kent transformed into his demi-dragon form, activating his wings.
He moved this time at a speed several times faster than the one he had used to approach the battleground.
The moment he moved, the sixteen individuals ambushing the lady sensed him. However, Kent came in very fast, and before any of them could move to intercept him, he was already on the ground.
He landed hard, activating the ’Flame Wheels’ skill, which created a powerful shockwave, pushing everyone away.
He grabbed hold of the lady, and before she could even realise what had happened, they were several kilometers away.
"My name is Kent. I was sent to rescue you and take you to Teleportation Mountains, so cooperate with me because whether you like it or not, we are now in this mess together."
Kent activated another flame skill and formed hundreds of fireballs in the air.
Looking back, he saw the sixteen masked individuals chasing them.
He hurled the fireballs at them, and the outcome was a powerful explosion.
"Where do you think you are going?" Suddenly, a powerful pressure fell from the heavens, sending Kent and Adina crashing to the ground.
From the clouds, a Level 6 Spirit Lord Dark Elf appeared, holding a colossal Axe.
"Great," Kent muttered, picking himself up and taking Adina’s hand.
"Can you still fight?" Kent asked, knowing there was no escape now. They had to fight...

He landed hard, activating the ’Flame Wheels’ skill, which created a powerful shockwave, pushing everyone away.
He grabbed hold of the lady, and before she could even realise what had happened, they were several kilometers away.
"My name is Kent.
I was sent to rescue you and take you to Teleportation Mountains, so cooperate with me because whether you like it or not, we are now in this mess together."
Kent activated another flame skill and formed hundreds of fireballs in the air.
Looking back, he saw the sixteen masked individuals chasing them.
He hurled the fireballs at them, and the outcome was a powerful explosion.
"Where do you think you are going?" Suddenly, a powerful pressure fell from the heavens, sending Kent and Adina crashing to the ground.
From the clouds, a Level 6 Spirit Lord Dark Elf appeared, holding a colossal Axe.
"Great," Kent muttered, picking himself up and taking Adina’s hand.
"Can you still fight?" Kent asked, knowing there was no escape now.
They had to fight...

chapters.title: Chapter 858: Short Battle, Dangerous Valley
paragraphs: ⟦They are the Red Devils Mercenary Guild from Planet Menelaus. The one in the air is their leader. I have already noted down the coordinates of their world.⟧
Though the tower is powerless when it comes to sending Kent and others into the tower space and out, it was more than able to get something valuable from the danger surrounding Kent and Adina.
"Can you still fight?" Kent asked Adina.
"I can fight, but I can’t handle more than two Spirit Kings," Adina answered Kent, who was already looking for a way out.
"Don’t worry, they are just small fries. I will handle the rest, you just have to hold back the Level 5 Spirit Lord for a few minutes," Kent said, knowing this wasn’t the time to look scared.
Not that he was scared.
If anything, turning into his dragon form had activated his Chaos Dragon bloodline, and as such, he was already getting restless to enter combat mode.
He was surrounded by four Spirit Lords and thirteen Spirit Sovereigns, but he wasn’t scared one bit. The only reason he hadn’t attacked yet was because of Adina.
If she dies, he will also die, so he has to protect her too.
That put him in a bind. However, his solution came in the form of Spirit Points.
’Tower, purchase ten of those items.’
He wasn’t even done with the command when the tower responded with the buy notification.
The Dark Elf in the air pointed at Kent and shouted...
"Hand over the girl, and maybe we will let you leave."
"What if I said no?" Kent asked, pointing his clawed hands back at the Dark Elf.
"Then you will die."
"I don’t think so. However, I have to say this. If you were to turn around and leave now, I will spare your lives."
All seventeen mercenaries burst out in resounding laughter, throwing their heads back. However, nobody was prepared for what happened next.
Kent pointed his clawed index finger at seven Spirit Soverigns. "You... you... And you, kill your teammates."
As if possessed, the seven Root Sovereigns he commanded stabbed their teammates from behind, ending them. It was brutal but quick and painless.
"Now!"

Kent shouted, throwing Adina with a force that sent her flying toward the level five Spirit King before shouting at the seven Spirit Soveriegns he had taken over. "Don’t just stand there, kill these bastards."
The seven who had just stabbed their teammates went through the heart, lunged at the second and third Spirit Kings.
Kent, on the other hand, looked at the level 6 Spirit King and smiled. "Shall we—"
He was already on the move before the words even left his lips.
BOOM
Kent clashed with the Dark Elf, sending him flying to the ground. ’I will use just one percent of my bloodline for now.’
Kent’s claw was coated with the Claw Aura, making every strike deadly. And thanks to using his bloodline power, every swing was powerful enough to keep the Dark Elf contained.
"I bet you didn’t see this coming." Kent swiped his claw, sending five arcs of flames at the Dark Elf.
He, in turn, swung his axe too, creating a swirling vortex. The two attacks met and canceled each other out. However, the outcome didn’t look good for the Dark Elf.
Kent activated the [Flame Wheels] and closed in, landing a powerful kick on the Dark Elf. The Dark Elf was sent flying back again.
Kent took out his sword and unleashed five clone bodies, sending them running toward the Dark Elf from different directions.
The Dark Elf came to a halt when he saw the five clones.
Of course, he lunged at the one closest and took him out, but before handling the second clone, Kent swapped places with the third, landing a cut on the Dark Elf’s body.
"Good chance." Kent swapped places with the fifth clone, which had run 5 km back. The moment he was 5 km away, he unleashed [Void Cleave].
The sword arc from the Void Cleave tore through the air, locking on the Dark Elf. He immediately felt the danger coming.
"Budha’s Palm."
Kent didn’t rest. He swapped places again with the fourth clone and unleashed one of the flame techniques he had learned from the Flame Tower.
A large palm appeared in the air and slammed hard on the Dark Elf.
The Void Cleave and the Flame Palm strikes left many injuries.
However, as a spirit Lord, the two attacks couldn’t take him out.
’Just two more minutes.’
Adina, on the other hand, was equally matched against the Spirit Lord she was fighting. Though she was hurt, her strength didn’t pale when facing the level 5 Spirit Lord.
She wouldn’t be able to kill him, but she was already making progress in the Stalling department.
The other Spirit Lords were also occupied.

Faced by multiple Spirits Sovereigns, they weren’t managing the situation well. Of course, the moment the ten-minute countdown reaches zero, the seven Spirit Sovereigns Kent used the Soul Torture on will drop dead.
But Kent wasn’t waiting for that to happen.
Before Kent used the Soul Torture on the seven Spirit Sovereigns, he had already made his main move, and that was already blooming.
However, until everything was set, they had to at least hold them back or kill them. Kent wasn’t going for the kill, since doing so would take more time.
After all, he was facing a Spirit Lord who was at level 6. Killing him wouldn’t be as easy as trashing him.
"Who are you?" After Kent sent the Dark Elf slamming into a nearby mountain again, he spat a mouthful of blood and pointed at Kent.
Physically, Kent was dominating him, but he wasn’t nearing the point where he would die yet. However, the shock he was going through after every strike left him dumbfounded.
"Just keep quiet, it is almost time."
"Almost time for what?" The Dark Elf wasn’t done speaking when a formation opened in the air, and his body started to glow.
"It is time for you to go. Don’t worry, I didn’t know where you would end up, but if you don’t die, you can come to look for me."
With the peace sign from his clawed fingers, the seventeen individuals vanished from sight. The formation sent away both the living and the dead.
Kent sighed, then he moved toward Adina, who was panting for breath.
"Are you alright?" Kent asked.
Adina nodded and turned to face him. She looked around for a few seconds, but after finding nothing, she turned back to Kent.
"Where are they?" she asked.
"I don’t know. I just sent them somewhere random." Kent turned back to his human form after the few wounds he had sustained healed.
⟦Master, I have mapped out the entire valley and created a map. The Teleportation Mountains are two weeks away.
However, this place is not simple. It has some dangerous beasts you will have to avoid.
Therefore, going straight through is not an option. To reach your destination, you will need to navigate using the map.
There are ten other teams currently looking for her. Additionally, I have informed your ladies that you are currently occupied with something, as they lost contact with you.
Also, there is a level 2 Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator after her, so avoiding him is of utmost priority.
However, the most critical thing here is that the lady doesn’t trust you and she wants to kill you when she gets the chance, so be careful.⟧
’Thank you, tower.’
Kent turned to Adina. "What is your name?"

chapters.title: Chapter 859: Building Trust
paragraphs: Adina looked at Kent weirdly, unsure if she wanted to reply to him.
Though Kent saved her when she desperately needed saving, she was now unsure if she could trust him.
It wasn’t that she had a choice but to work with him to handle the mercenaries, but now that she had a moment to think, she started to suspect Kent.
But she also saw Kent’s strength, and that gave her the confirmation that Kent was no ordinary person, despite having a cultivation base that was many stages below hers.
Of course, she also disliked men, which added to her skepticism.
"My name is Kendra." In the end, she gave Kent a fake name. If she could, she would have already vanished, but she knew it wasn’t that simple at the moment.
Kent smiled and walked toward a cliff overlooking the vast land before him.
"First of all, you dont have to lie to me.
I am a human lie detector.
That said, your name is Adina. You are a succubus and the Sin of Lust. I know you are trying to reach the Teleportation Mountains, and while you don’t know this, ten more teams are coming after you.

Now, I don’t know if you also know this, but this valley is dangerous, and even if you have a way to get to your destination, I don’t suppose you can dodge all ten teams and the potential beasts lurking."
Kent turned toward her and smiled before saying, "I can get you there if you can trust me, and don’t worry, I have no plans on hurting you.
I have a life to get back to, and the faster I get you to the Teleportation Mountain, the quicker I can return to my life."
Adina didn’t talk, but Kent could tell from the weary look that appeared in her eyes that she was now more wary of him than ever.
’Just who is this person and how can he know all this about me?’ Like the tower said, if she gets the chance, she will kill Kent.
However, a part of her kept telling her not to do anything stupid.
Of course, as someone who had abstained from sex all her life, she was even more wary of Kent, who was a male—and a handsome one at that.
So, aside from not having many reasons to trust Kent, she was also scared of what spending a few moments around him would do to her.
After all, she may have abstained, but she was a succubus, and this isn’t the dream garden where only women surround her. Kent is a man, and as such, she was scared of him.
"Use this time to think about whether or not you want to trust me. But we have to move now and find a place for you to heal first," Kent said, starting to fly away.
After standing there for a few seconds, Adina took to the air and flew after him.
[200,000 miles away from the location of the battle — The Wandering Demon Swordsman POV]
A red-skinned demon holding a jagged black sword and clad in tattered cloth suddenly appeared inside the Valley of Torture.
He appeared in the domain of a Level 5 Root Sovereign Serpent beast, which immediately lunged at him with poison when he appeared.
However, without even looking, he swung his sword, sending a wave of razor-sharp, profound sword aura, shredding the serpent instantly.
Blood flowed from the body of the serpent, but didn’t remain on the ground.
The moment the serpent was shredded into many pieces, the red-skinned demon inhaled, and the blood turned into a red mist that flew into his nose.
"Haaa."
The red-skinned demon exhaled.
"This place will be fun for a while. But first, I need to look for that bitch."
A bat wing appeared behind him, and with a speed several times faster than Kent’s, he took to the sky and was many miles away in an instant.
He is the Wandering Demon Swordsman, a Level 2 Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator and a Sword King.
While Kent doesn’t even know it yet, one of the requirements to become a Sword Sage has arrived in the same valley he was in.
And with the Wandering Demon Swordsman after the person Kent is protecting, they are eventually bound to meet.
Meanwhile, Kent and Adina were currently flying toward the mountain that the tower recommended. It had no beasts lurking around and was a good spot for a quick escape in case they were tracked there.
Kent first scouted the mountain and, after making sure it was indeed empty, he led Adina in.
"Rest for now. I will stand guard and plan out the next path." He took out a few fruits from his tower storage and handed them over to her.
"Eat. They will help speed up your healing."
Adina accepted the fruits but didn’t immediately start eating them. Kent said nothing more and walked away from the cave.
He had already marked her, so even if she were to run away, he could easily find her. The only thing he was worried about was somebody killing her.

But wasting time to convince her she could trust him wasn’t something Kent was looking forward to, so he left to get a good read on the map and find a way to reach the Teleportation Mountains much faster.
Back inside the cave, Adina kept staring at the fruits for several minutes before taking a Spirit grape fruit and slowly placing it in her mouth.
Of course, when she bit into it and the energy washed into her body, her eyes widened. She immediately took another grape and ate it.
"This is a Spirit grape fruit... and... and there are a lot of them."
She couldn’t believe her eyes.
Something so rare that to get it, one would have to spend millions of spirit stones, had just been given to her as if it were an ordinary fruit.
She quickly checked the other fruits, and to her shock, they were also rare fruits worth millions, perhaps billions.
"Where did he get this many fruits?" She quickly stored some in her space ring, planning to give them to her sister once they reunited. Then she started eating the small amount she left on the plate.
In no time, she was completely healed, so she decided to cultivate the residual energy in her body, which began to raise her cultivation base.
Ten hours later, she opened her eyes, leveling up to the Level 4 Spirit Lord stage. Her mind had also become much stronger, and so had her soul.
She sat down and started to think of her next plan. Now that she had reached Level 4, she felt even stronger, so she began weighing her options.
However, just a few minutes into her thinking, Kent walked into the cave holding a chunk of grilled meat.
It was the thigh of a beast, and judging by how dripping and oily it was, Kent had gone deep into the grilling process.
"I have mapped out a path that will take us far from this place. Let’s eat first, and I will explain everything."
Using a dagger he bought from the tower store, he started cutting small chunks. After that was done, he passed a plate full of the meat to Adina before he started eating his share.
"There is no poison in it if that is what you are worried about," Kent said when he noticed Adina’s gaze on him.
Of course, he went back to his meal the next second, ignoring the stares coming from Adina.

chapters.title: Chapter 860: The First Plan
paragraphs: They ate in silence.
Kent knew that she would start asking questions soon, so he didn’t bother asking her any questions throughout the meal.
The silent treatment wasn’t him being petty; instead, he merely wanted to see how far Adina would go to keep her distance from him.

After all, Kent came there for a mission, and knowing his life was linked to hers wasn’t something he took lightly. If he were there on his own accord, he wouldn’t mind teasing her in an attempt to get her to open up.
Even so, Kent had already made plans to get them closer to their destination, so being friendly to her was but a side quest he wasn’t planning on taking seriously.
After they were done eating, Kent took out a map and made it hover before him.
"This is the map of the Valley of Torture. Don’t ask me how I got it, for I don’t plan on telling you. That said, as you can see, there are three different color markings on it.
The black ones are the various mercenary groups sent after you for reasons I don’t know, and I don’t plan on asking if you don’t want to tell me.

The green marks are the beasts above the Spirit Sovereign stage. As you can see, there are thousands of them. We can’t reach our destination without crossing paths with them, so be prepared for some significant battles.

As for the red marks, they indicate the naturally hazardous areas in this valley. There are six of them, and our only hope of getting to the teleportation mountains is to use these six places to our advantage.
I know they are dangerous, but I also believe that with our combined brains, we can reach our destination.
Though I have to say, our only chance at getting to the teleportation mountains rests on whether we are several steps ahead of our enemies.

I have some plans, but while killing up to Spirit Sovereign can be managed by me, the Spirit Lords aren’t something I can easily handle, so we’d better be careful, and the only way to become careful is if there is some level of trust between us.
I don’t expect you to become best friends with me or laugh with me. None of that is important if you are not comfortable doing so.
However, you should trust me enough to follow the plans I have in mind. If you can do that, then I believe we will be getting to our destination soon enough."
Adina didn’t say anything and only continued to stare at Kent.
It was as if she didn’t know how to speak, which was annoying considering Kent wanted to end the mission much faster and return to his training.

This isn’t the tower time, so a day spent on the outside is 24 days he could have spent improving himself and making up for the strength he was still lacking compared to the perfect self he faced in the "perfect chamber."
"How did you know my name and who I was?" Adina suddenly asked, looking coldly at Kent. She still didn’t know why Kent knew she was the Sin of Lust or, more importantly, her name.
"I won’t sugarcoat it, so listen carefully. I know things. I know you, and while I want to waste time telling you how I know all about you, I would rather spend that saving you.
You needed help, and instead of being truthful, you chose to lie. That wasn’t a good sign of someone who needed saving. So I used my own way to figure out who you are and what you are."
"Then who sent you?" Adina asked again.
"I have no idea. However, you should know that, in a rather unexpected and annoying way, getting you to your destination is a must if I want to get back to my life.
So, for the sake of me getting my life back, work with me and let’s both leave here in one piece."

Adina narrowed her gaze at Kent for a full minute before a small sigh escaped her lips. She would love to run, but she had listened to what Kent said and knew that to get to their destination, they indeed had to work together.
"I will work with you. But should you try anything funny, I will kill you, and trust me, I can kill you," Adina warned.

Kent smirked, looking at her with a smile on his face. "Trust me, the last thing I want is to waste time doing unnecessary things. So be assured, I don’t plan on doing anything funny. Getting you to your destination is my priority."
Kent gently tapped the map, and a 3D projection of it appeared, startling Adina. Kent ignored her shocked expression and focused on the map instead.
"This is the topography of the entire valley." Kent pointed to a range of mountains on the right side of the map. "That place is our destination, and as you can see, it is millions of miles away.

Of course, we are cultivators, meaning we can travel several miles a day. However, even so, if we were to fly to the teleportation mountains every day nonstop, it would still take us two weeks to get there.
But we can’t do that, considering people are looking for you and beasts lurking in the shadows.
So we first have to take it slow, and I have already found a path that will lead us several thousand miles away from here."

The map zoomed in on a marked location. "This is our next destination. It is a lightning mountain, and to get there, we have to move through this lane. It has some beasts, but none are at a stage we can’t handle if we work together."
Adina studied the map for a few seconds before asking a question. "Is there a reason why we have to go through the Lightning Peak?"

Kent nodded. "There is something there I need. If things go as planned, we will be several miles away from that place in a few days. But even if we don’t get what I am after, that place is a good spot to lure the nearest team into an ambush.
Remember, the only reason we have to be extra cautious is because of the mercenary teams after you. The beasts can be dodged or dealt with, so we have to use every chance we can get to handle them.
But the people, on the other hand, are crafty, so we must be extra careful. Even so, I plan on killing them all if I get the chance, so prepare in advance for some major battles."
Adina nodded, knowing the plan was indeed sound.

Though Kent didn’t tell her what he was after, causing them to go through the Lightning Peak, she knew, given his resourcefulness, which was now evident, they would indeed be getting close to their destination by following the path he had made.
"When do we leave?" she asked.
"Now."
A few minutes later, they were on their way to their first destination among many leading to the teleportation mountains.
