chapters.title: Chapter 887: The Last Member
paragraphs: "So you are telling me the Cult of Wisdom made contact with the world you are in and that you solved their puzzles," Vexthra asked through the harem connection, sounding as calm as she looked.
[It’s as I said. One minute, I was enjoying my food; the next second, I was solving puzzles. It was fun to get that technical, but it ruined my vacation.]
"First of all, congratulations on joining the Cult of Wisdom."
[Hold on. Who said I have joined them? I merely solved a puzzle that revealed they had poisoned the Empress of this world and the alliance head. The moment I solve the last puzzle, I will vanish.]
Kent didn’t expect Vexthra to congratulate him.

"No need to look scared, Kent. The Cult of Wisdom is one of the most powerful cults in the universe. They are powerful and, most importantly, knowledgeable. In the entire universe, if you are looking for a source of information, they are the best people.

You may not realize their importance now, but trust me, one day, when you need something very important and your standing in the Cult of Wisdom is high enough, obtaining it will be but something very trivial."
Kent listened to Vexthra speak, and the more he heard her, the more he started to sense there was more to the Cult of Wisdom than the pale look he saw on the faces of people of Manelaus.
"Many gods, myself included, tried to join the Cult of Wisdom but failed, so for my sake, please join. As it happens, I need some information, and that can only be found in the Cult of Wisdom.

Of course, whether you want to or not, the moment you solve their puzzle, the seal of wisdom is imprinted on you, and, like you said, the trial of wisdom in ten years will be when it awakens. So good luck, my love... I am proud of you."
Kent smirked.
Soon, they arrived at the store where the last puzzle was.
The three heavenly Ascension stage experts leading the way cleared everyone from the store by unleashing their wild auras.
Kent, who was already looking to have some fun before getting back to the sect, smirked and then walked to the left side of the grand store and picked a box sitting on a dusty shelf.
He walked out and placed his hand on it.
Soon, he appeared inside the Puzzle Realm, where he quickly went to work. Though this puzzle ruined his vacation, he had to admit he enjoyed solving the four puzzles.
A few moments later, he opened his eyes, and the box opened. The moment it did, a token flew and entered Kent’s forehead. At that moment, the quest message appeared.
Kent lifted two jade boxes inside the box and handed them to Life Emperor Hael, then, with a peace sign and a grin, he vanished, startling everyone.
Kent went into the tower and then, using a marker he had left in Miracle City, he appeared there and quickly took his true appearance.
Kent soon left the city and started heading to Lison City, where he would deliver the wandering demon swordsman’s head.
He had already had enough, and knowing he couldn’t use his main face too much here, he knew he had to get things done fast.
He had no plans to use Chaos’s face or the Faceless as his new disguise. After all, he had plans for these faces, and using them now would be a waste.
[Immortal World - Planet Enigma - The Cult of Wisdom Headquarters]
Planet Enigma is a world known to hold the most brilliant cultivators in the universe.
After all, it is where the Cult of Wisdom headquarters is located. Aside from members who bear the seal of wisdom and have been granted permission by the Lord of Wisdom, no one else may enter.
Even gods cannot enter without permission from the proper and appropriate sources.
On Planet Enigma, there are several towers called the Tower of Wisdom. Inside them are scrolls containing knowledge spanning several billion years.

Although difficult to obtain, the Cult of Wisdom is said to possess deep knowledge from the Primordial Era. This makes them one of the very few to hold such knowledge, and perhaps the only ones to have some parts of the many secrets that went extinct after the Primordial Era fell.
At this moment, inside the main Tower of Wisdom sat an Immortal Lord reading a large scroll several meters long.
The look in his eyes and on his face showed great focus. He appeared to be chasing after something within the scroll, yet no matter what path he took, the thing always seemed to elude him.
However, despite many failures, he remained serious and hopeful that he would be able to acquire the knowledge he sought.
Suddenly, the door opened, and another immortal—this one an Immortal Monarch, one stage below the Immortal Lord—walked into the hall holding a small scroll.
"Lord of Wisdom, I have a report on the last Wisdom Seal." The Immortal Lord paused, raising his eyes to look at the man.
"Speak," he said calmly, yet the power behind his words made the Immortal Monarch exhale deeply before beginning.

"The last candidate for the Trial of Wisdom has been found on Planet Manelaus. It is a newly ascended Great High World. The report states that the one who passed our test is named Jest. He is a Core Formation expert and a human.
He solved the riddles in under four minutes.

He solved the first puzzle in under three minutes, the second in under five minutes, the third in under a minute, and the last in under three minutes, recording the second-highest time ever for solving a puzzle from the Cult of Wisdom in our history."
The Lord of Wisdom closed the scroll he was reading and extended his hand. The scroll in the Immortal Monarch’s hand flew into his grasp.
He read through the content and repeated the process three more times before a smile appeared on his lips.
"A Core Formation expert who was able to solve our riddles and puzzles in under 25 minutes. The last time that happened was several million years ago.
Even then, the ancestor solved the puzzles while at the Spirit Ascension stage. So, to think this person accomplished the same at the Core Formation stage..."
A look of respect appeared on the Lord of Wisdom’s face.
"Tell them to keep an eye on this Jest."
The Immortal Monarch sighed, "I am afraid that won’t be possible. Outside the report, they said he vanished after solving the last puzzle."

The Lord of Wisdom nodded. "When the Trial of Wisdom is near, he will surface again. For now, keep a lookout for where he will appear next, and should he need help, the Cult should assist him from the shadows."
The Immortal Monarch bowed and left.
The Lord of Wisdom looked at the content on the scroll for a few more minutes before putting it away.
He opened the large scroll again and started reading once more. Hopefully, with this good news he had received, he would be able to use it to find what he was looking for.

Of course, whether you want to or not, the moment you solve their puzzle, the seal of wisdom is imprinted on you, and, like you said, the trial of wisdom in ten years will be when it awakens.
So good luck, my love...
I am proud of you."
Kent smirked.
Soon, they arrived at the store where the last puzzle was.
The three heavenly Ascension stage experts leading the way cleared everyone from the store by unleashing their wild auras.
Kent, who was already looking to have some fun before getting back to the sect, smirked and then walked to the left side of the grand store and picked a box sitting on a dusty shelf.
He walked out and placed his hand on it.
Soon, he appeared inside the Puzzle Realm, where he quickly went to work.
Though this puzzle ruined his vacation, he had to admit he enjoyed solving the four puzzles.
A few moments later, he opened his eyes, and the box opened.
The moment it did, a token flew and entered Kent’s forehead.
At that moment, the quest message appeared.
Kent lifted two jade boxes inside the box and handed them to Life Emperor Hael, then, with a peace sign and a grin, he vanished, startling everyone.
Kent went into the tower and then, using a marker he had left in Miracle City, he appeared there and quickly took his true appearance.
Kent soon left the city and started heading to Lison City, where he would deliver the wandering demon swordsman’s head.
He had already had enough, and knowing he couldn’t use his main face too much here, he knew he had to get things done fast.
He had no plans to use Chaos’s face or the Faceless as his new disguise.
After all, he had plans for these faces, and using them now would be a waste.
[Immortal World - Planet Enigma - The Cult of Wisdom Headquarters]
Planet Enigma is a world known to hold the most brilliant cultivators in the universe.
After all, it is where the Cult of Wisdom headquarters is located.
Aside from members who bear the seal of wisdom and have been granted permission by the Lord of Wisdom, no one else may enter.
Even gods cannot enter without permission from the proper and appropriate sources.
On Planet Enigma, there are several towers called the Tower of Wisdom.
Inside them are scrolls containing knowledge spanning several billion years.
Although difficult to obtain, the Cult of Wisdom is said to possess deep knowledge from the Primordial Era.
This makes them one of the very few to hold such knowledge, and perhaps the only ones to have some parts of the many secrets that went extinct after the Primordial Era fell.
At this moment, inside the main Tower of Wisdom sat an Immortal Lord reading a large scroll several meters long.
The look in his eyes and on his face showed great focus.
He appeared to be chasing after something within the scroll, yet no matter what path he took, the thing always seemed to elude him.
However, despite many failures, he remained serious and hopeful that he would be able to acquire the knowledge he sought.
Suddenly, the door opened, and another immortal—this one an Immortal Monarch, one stage below the Immortal Lord—walked into the hall holding a small scroll.
"Lord of Wisdom, I have a report on the last Wisdom Seal." The Immortal Lord paused, raising his eyes to look at the man.
"Speak," he said calmly, yet the power behind his words made the Immortal Monarch exhale deeply before beginning.
"The last candidate for the Trial of Wisdom has been found on Planet Manelaus.
It is a newly ascended Great High World.
The report states that the one who passed our test is named Jest.
He is a Core Formation expert and a human.
He solved the riddles in under four minutes.

He solved the first puzzle in under three minutes, the second in under five minutes, the third in under a minute, and the last in under three minutes, recording the second-highest time ever for solving a puzzle from the Cult of Wisdom in our history."
The Lord of Wisdom closed the scroll he was reading and extended his hand.
The scroll in the Immortal Monarch’s hand flew into his grasp.
He read through the content and repeated the process three more times before a smile appeared on his lips.
"A Core Formation expert who was able to solve our riddles and puzzles in under 25 minutes.
The last time that happened was several million years ago.
Even then, the ancestor solved the puzzles while at the Spirit Ascension stage.
So, to think this person accomplished the same at the Core Formation stage..."
A look of respect appeared on the Lord of Wisdom’s face.
"Tell them to keep an eye on this Jest."
The Immortal Monarch sighed, "I am afraid that won’t be possible.
Outside the report, they said he vanished after solving the last puzzle."
The Lord of Wisdom nodded.
"When the Trial of Wisdom is near, he will surface again.
For now, keep a lookout for where he will appear next, and should he need help, the Cult should assist him from the shadows."
The Immortal Monarch bowed and left.
The Lord of Wisdom looked at the content on the scroll for a few more minutes before putting it away.
He opened the large scroll again and started reading once more.
Hopefully, with this good news he had received, he would be able to use it to find what he was looking for.

chapters.title: Chapter 888: Who Are You...?
paragraphs: Lison City is a grand city of its own beauty and grandeur.
Miracle City is beautiful, calm, and serene. However, when compared to Lison City, it is mighty and exudes an aura of power.

Naturally, Lison City is the largest city on all of Planet Manelaus. Its size alone is three times that of Earth, and Kent, who had just arrived before the 40 km tall gate, could only stand and stare at it with puppy eyes.

At the moment, he was clad in a white inner robe with a deep V-neck, layered under a black outer robe. The sleeves were wide and flowing, with white fabric and black geometric patterns near the upper arms.
Just like his sleeves, he wore loose black trousers tucked slightly at the ankle area and black arm wraps covering the forearms.
He had a sword sheathed at his side and wore black footwear that blended futuristic Earth style with fantasy and medieval cultivation world design.
Kent wanted to copy Jest’s dressing back in the day, but with his own modern take, which ended up quite well.
As he stood, people couldn’t help but admire his clothes. Naturally, it was a bad idea to appear that eye-catching; however, Kent wasn’t really looking to leave without making noise.

Since his quiet life as a Life Saint was shattered by the Cult of Wisdom, he could only focus on the next best thing, and that was to ignite what had already been the main topic of discussion before the puzzle incident in Miracle City.
The line entering the city was rather long.
It took Kent 6 hours to get to the front.
When it came to his turn to enter the city, he had to pay ten high-level Spirit stones. Naturally, Kent expected more than that, but since it was cheap, he paid and entered.
"This place is like a whole world on its own," Kent muttered, looking at the vast land spreading as far as the eye could see.
It took him six days to reach Lison City after leaving Miracle City in his small flying boat.
The moment Kent entered the city, he started heading toward the best place he could gather information that his Enchanted Eyes couldn’t give him.
A few hours later, he came to a stop in front of a restaurant where the traffic seemed intense. People were coming and going at a steady rate.
Kent walked in and, as expected, was greeted with a happy smile.
He ordered his food and, like a gentleman, started eating while spreading the Soul map to pick up on all conversations happening inside the restaurant.

Kent had already signed up for the gory and weird conversations that he might hear from the moment he received the Soul map, so he didn’t seem flustered when he picked up on some rather not-to-be-remembered conversations.
Thankfully, he was able to block them out.
Eventually, he picked up on a conversation that piqued his interest.
Inside a VIP room, two people were having a conversation.

"I can’t believe out of the 11 teams that went after one target, only three returned," one of them said. Kent immediately knew this conversation had something to do with the quest he had in the Valley of Torture.
After all, he killed 8 teams out of the eleven that entered.

"It is weird. However, I heard the vice leader of the Red Devils also returned. When questioned, he only stated that when they appeared, the target they were after had a powerful helper they couldn’t handle.
At first, I assumed he was just messing around until he revealed that even the Wandering Demon Swordsman was on the same mission as them.
However, even days before he managed to escape, the target was still at large, meaning not even the terrifying Wandering Demon Swordsman was able to get to her.
"It is very weird that a mission would demand attention from that maniac. But I suppose the one who survived was lucky.
I learned he even retired as a mercenary and decided to follow the Dao of the spear from now onwards."
"Good for him. To be able to return from a mission where all your teammates are dead is something that not many can recover from. At least he found a path to walk."
"I suppose."
Kent smiled, hearing about Iver, his mind-controlled helper who eventually became something akin to a friend.
Kent readily ate his food and then paid before leaving the place. Soon, he was standing in front of a large teleportation platform.
"Where does this swordsman want to go?" the man operating the teleportation channel asked when he saw Kent.
"I would like to go to the Olive Sword Guild," Kent answered.

"That will be 2,000 high-quality spirit stones." Kent gave it to him and stood inside the formation. Soon, the man activated the transfer channel, and within seconds, the surroundings changed for Kent.
He appeared on another platform. The surroundings were different compared to the large and tall buildings he saw in the first part of the city.
"It is like a whole different city here," Kent said.
Unlike where he came from, this place had stores selling weapons. Some smithing workshops and a few cultivation rooms. There are also normal Inns and grand hotels all over.
Kent wasn’t found using the Soul map inside the city because there was no censorship plugin to block the nasty stuff.
Using it inside the city will reveal things he would rather not see, so for his mental health, unless he truly had no other way, he wouldn’t use the soul Map in the city.
"Please, I want directions to the Olive Sword Guild," Kent asked the man controlling the teleportation formation, and the man pointed west of his current position.
"Walk 1,200 km that way."
Kent thanked him, and soon, he was gone. It took him a couple of minutes, considering he was walking very fast.
Soon, he appeared in front of a gate made of swords. At the tip of the sword sat an olive made of metal. Kent walked toward it, and when he was at the entrance, he was stopped by three guards.
"State your business," one said, looking at him with disdain as they asked the question.
"I am here to submit my mission I completed."
Naturally, Iver had already told Kent what he had to say should he appear before the Olive Sword Guild entrance.
The two guards looked at Kent closely, and then they waved for him to enter. ’Tch, a bunch of sword sages think they are better than me.’
Kent also did not like being looked down on by a bunch of wannabe sword Sages, so he planned to teach them a lesson one of these days, should their paths cross again.
For now, he walked inside, and soon he was standing at the centre of a large hall where dozens of swordsmen were going about their business.
Kent walked to a counter where he could see a lady handing pouches to the swordsmen who came to submit their missions.
’All I have to do is give them the head, and the mission will be considered complete, right?’
⟦Yes, master. Just hand in the head and the mission will be wrapped. The rewards will be transported into your tower storage.⟧
"How can I be of help, young swordsman?" the lady whom Kent sensed a powerful, profound sword aura from asked the moment Kent appeared before her counter.
"I would like to submit my completed mission."
"What was your mission?" the lady asked.
Kent smiled and flicked his hand, "Head of the Wandering Demon Swordsman."
At once, the entire hall became quiet when they heard Kent’s sentence. Then their eyes landed on the head, and like pouring ice on them, they all turned pale.
The counter lady looked from the head to Kent, then back to the head, and back to Kent again. She repeated that a few times before asking a question.
"Who are you?"
Kent smiled yet again, "My dear, you can call me Kent Madson."
With that, Kent snapped his fingers, and his body turned purple, then burst into a quiet dust of purple light.
"Until next time, you all."
Just like that, the mysterious Kent Madson that the entire universe was looking for had made his appearance in a jaw-dropping manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 889: Kent Madson’s Appearance
paragraphs: Within 24 hours, the news of Kent’s sudden appearance in Manelaus had spread far and wide, reaching thousands of worlds.
Millions stormed planet Manelaus, all with the same goal: to find Kent Madson.
Of course, their true intentions remained in their heads.

However, when they arrived, Kent was already gone, as the reports had stated. Many were furious that they couldn’t meet Kent Madson. However, those who took the time to think discovered that Kent had killed the unkillable, bringing back his head.
They began connecting the dots, and that was when they found out the killing had happened in the Valley of Torture.
Those with the wit decided to investigate, and what they found shocked everyone.
In the span of three days, Kent became a person whose nature rivalled the gods, and many simply couldn’t understand how any of it was possible.
Before killing the wandering demon swordsman, Kent left him many messages. Some were found by the dead demon, and some he missed.
However, thanks to these people’s hunger to find Kent, they managed to uncover most of these messages.
The messages spread far and wide.
That was when everyone came to learn of Kent’s true strength and the kind of monster he is. It all made sense somehow, yet the shock even left immortals scratching their heads.
[Planet Mekyn - Elven Garden - Lady Enyo, High Priestess, and Adina’s POV]
The three heaven-defying beauties sat under a white blossom tree, reading a report that had just reached them.
"Unbelievable. It’s hard to believe he actually managed to kill a level 2 heavenly Ascension stage expert. Just what is this Kent Madson made of?" Lady Enyo said, rereading the report.
Adina smiled, looking at the shocked expressions on the faces of the two ladies. "I already told you. Kent is no simple person. Many expected him to be an immortal or even a god.
But the True Kent Madson was but a mere Core Formation brat, and now, he had justified why his name appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet."

The High Priestess, who still hadn’t recovered from the shock Kent had put her in by giving her a god-grade cloning technique, looked at the smile on Adina’s face, and all she could think of was meeting Kent.
She understood that fighting one realm above your own is normal. Some even go as far as fighting two or even three realms above their own.
However, to go as far as fighting someone seven realms above your own was just defying the norms at this point.
Lady Enyo laughed, unsure of how to handle the issue. "Those monsters in the Supreme High Worlds would be furious by now.
From what I know, the strongest among them can at least fight five realms above their own, but even killing someone five realms above them is unheard of.

"I must meet this Kent Madson and, if possible, become his disciple." Lady Enyo stood up with a smile on her face. She looked at the High Priestess. "Runa, make sure Adina takes her cultivation seriously. I will be in seclusion for at least three months to attempt breaking the next limit."
The High Priestess nodded, and soon, Lady Enyo was gone from the garden.
Adina and the High Priestess stayed for a few minutes before they left to handle their own business.
[Unknown Place - Pill Immortal Nefeli’s POV]
It had already been months since Pill Monarch Nefeli started having these strange memories of Kent popping up in her mind.
At first, she thought she was going mad; however, it all started making sense when she found out Pill Immortal Suoh was also having similar memories.
So when she heard Kent’s name had appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet, making him the 14th to appear on such a heavenly tablet, she set out to track someone.
The journey was one she knew would be dangerous; however, someone with her strength wasn’t going to cower just because of a perilous journey.
She was standing in an unknown space, staring at a message she had received from Yuna, her maid.
"How is this possible? From my memories, when we met, he was also a Core Formation expert, and that was over 300 thousand years ago, so how is he still a Core Formation expert?"

Pill Immortal Nefeli wondered, looking at the message. For a moment, she thought she was going mad, or perhaps dreaming. However, she recovered the next second and decided to discard the thought from her mind for now.
The fact that she has these memories, even if they don’t tally with her current thought processes, holds a much deeper meaning, so one day she will find that meaning.
"It will all make sense one of these days."
With that, she continued her journey, unsure when she would reach her destination.
[Supreme High World - Planet Mibos - Nine Royals Sword Sect]
Planet Mibos is one of the Ten Sword Worlds in the High World. It is said to house some of the greatest swordsmen one can find in a High World.
They produced many legendary swordsmen who went on to dominate the universe. Legend even has it that they had some connection to Lord Genesis, the father of all swordsmen.
However, whether that is true, nobody truly knows.
At the moment, in the top sword sect in the world, many disciples were staring at their communication tablets with strange expressions.
They had just learned of the one person who had shaken their hearts and minds a few weeks ago.
"Somehow, this unknown Kent Madson has found his way back into our lives, and this time he has even set the bar this high," a disciple said, sitting down on the ground, unsure of how to feel.

"The bar is indeed too high. Although he is in a Great High World, the fact that he had killed someone seven realms above him, and even this person was a Sword King, while he was a mere Sword Saint, is more than enough to know he is several times more talented than they paint him to be."
"Do you think the Nine Sword Royals can contend with him?"
The person wasn’t even done speaking when suddenly, the space cracked in nine different places, and nine Sword Emperors stepped out.
The moment everyone saw them, they bowed. "We greet the Nine Sword Royals."

Every ten thousand years, the sect selects nine heaven-defying talents in the sword path and nurtures them to become the next nine to storm the immortal worlds and become the next generation of swordsmen that would shake the universe.
The nine that appeared—six men and three ladies—are the current Nine Sword Royals, and they had come out of a thousand-year seclusion.
Naturally, everyone knew the reason why they came, but none dared say it in fear of losing their heads.

However, Kent’s sudden feat had brought them out, and while they appeared calm on the outside, inwardly, they knew they wouldn’t be able to cultivate effectively until they got their hands on Kent and defeated him.
One of them, a level 8 Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator who is a Sword Emperor with a level 6 Heavenly Sword Aura, stepped forward, cracking the space under his foot as he walked through the air.
"Spread the word. The Nine Sword Royals will be participating in the upcoming Mount Genesis Supreme Sword competition. Those who dare can sign up."

With that, they vanished, and as they intended, words spread everywhere, indirectly sending a challenge to Kent that in 15 years’ time, if he dares, he should sign up for the upcoming Mount Genesis Supreme Sword competition, the greatest sword competition held every 10,000 years.

At the moment, in the top sword sect in the world, many disciples were staring at their communication tablets with strange expressions.
They had just learned of the one person who had shaken their hearts and minds a few weeks ago.
"Somehow, this unknown Kent Madson has found his way back into our lives, and this time he has even set the bar this high," a disciple said, sitting down on the ground, unsure of how to feel.
"The bar is indeed too high.

Although he is in a Great High World, the fact that he had killed someone seven realms above him, and even this person was a Sword King, while he was a mere Sword Saint, is more than enough to know he is several times more talented than they paint him to be."
"Do you think the Nine Sword Royals can contend with him?"
The person wasn’t even done speaking when suddenly, the space cracked in nine different places, and nine Sword Emperors stepped out.
The moment everyone saw them, they bowed.
"We greet the Nine Sword Royals."

Every ten thousand years, the sect selects nine heaven-defying talents in the sword path and nurtures them to become the next nine to storm the immortal worlds and become the next generation of swordsmen that would shake the universe.
The nine that appeared—six men and three ladies—are the current Nine Sword Royals, and they had come out of a thousand-year seclusion.
Naturally, everyone knew the reason why they came, but none dared say it in fear of losing their heads.

However, Kent’s sudden feat had brought them out, and while they appeared calm on the outside, inwardly, they knew they wouldn’t be able to cultivate effectively until they got their hands on Kent and defeated him.
One of them, a level 8 Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator who is a Sword Emperor with a level 6 Heavenly Sword Aura, stepped forward, cracking the space under his foot as he walked through the air.
"Spread the word.
The Nine Sword Royals will be participating in the upcoming Mount Genesis Supreme Sword competition.
Those who dare can sign up."

With that, they vanished, and as they intended, words spread everywhere, indirectly sending a challenge to Kent that in 15 years’ time, if he dares, he should sign up for the upcoming Mount Genesis Supreme Sword competition, the greatest sword competition held every 10,000 years.

chapters.title: Chapter 890: Old Swords Ascension
paragraphs: After making his appearance in Manelaus, Kent didn’t immediately return to the sect.

Using the chaos caused by him, he reverted to his Jest persona and went to Farrah City, where he, in a not-so-subtle and inviting way, brought out his ladies to spend some time away from their missions.
They had been working really hard the past few months, so he wanted them to have some fun.
Kent made sure each of them arrived at different times, and when they had all arrived, he spent seven days going around the various places his ladies wanted to visit.
After accompanying them, he returned to the sect.

Old Sword would be ascending soon, and he planned to send him to Manelaus, from where he could then easily get to Planet Earia, which, according to what Kent had found out, was a hub for swordsmen and those looking to join powerful sects.
Kent made all the arrangements for him and was only waiting for him to be ready before handing everything over.
Naturally, he spent a couple of days talking to Lady Enzi and Liora, who was still thankful to Kent for setting her disciple straight.
Two weeks later, the time for Old Sword to ascend to a high world arrived.
Kent was cultivating on the abandoned mountain when Old Sword came to see him. Today was a big day for him, after all.
"You seem ready," Kent said the moment his eyes landed on Old Sword.
"I am ready. I have tied up all loose ends and am now ready to ascend," he said, walking over and sitting down beside Kent.
Kent sensed his aura and knew the man was indeed ready to get back out there. The medium worlds can’t contain him anymore.

"The sword manual I gave you is something you should pay very close attention to. It contains a method to re-comprehend your sword realm. But even before doing that, it will allow you to further strengthen your sword foundation."
Kent threw a pouch at him.

"Inside is a key to a cultivation room in a city called Farrah. I have paid for 30 years. It has a powerful formation that will allow you to easily absorb the spiritual energy in the air to break through.
Use it to break through to the Spirit Ascension stage.
Once that is done, you can leave for Planet Earia. However, before then, learn at least one of the sword techniques I gave you, and please, strengthen your sword realm before going to that world.
You have 30 years paid for, so use the cultivation room well.
As for your final destination, which is Planet Earia, it is the strongest world in that alliance and the only place where you will get the best training as a swordsman.
Join a sect or wander around and sharpen your swordsmanship.
There are enough high-level spirit stones in there to keep you going for at least 100 years. The rest, you can handle on your own."
"Thank you, Kent. I will be sure to repay this kindness one day."
Kent smiled and said, "Don’t worry about it. After all, we are sworn brothers, and it is only natural for brothers to help each other."
Old Sword smiled faintly, knowing he was in no way wealthy enough to repay Kent in money, so he resolved in his belief, "Even still, one of these days, I will be sure to pay you back."
"Then become strong. In fact, become so strong that long before you become an immortal, you will have the power to kill them."
Old Sword could only smile and nod.

"Also, there are a couple of spirit fruits in there. Use them to strengthen your foundation and sell some if you need urgent money. After all, the place you are going is a Great High world—one mistake and your head will come rolling."
After their talk, Kent gave Old Sword the method he had prepared for him to get to Planet Manelaus.
"This is a Tier 12 Array talisman. It contains a transfer array that will override the transfer channel of the ascension platform you will be using.
This means you can leave in the grand way you had planned. However, instead of taking you to the Legacy High World you had in mind, you will appear in a city called Farrah City on Planet Manelaus.
And before I forget, whatever you hear about Kent Madson, pretend you don’t know me. It is for your own good."
Old Sword seemed surprised to hear that. However, he nodded and placed the warning at the center of his mind.
A couple of hours later, Old Sword was ready to go.
The sect Elders, from the Outer sect up to the Core sect, were all gathered to send him off, as they always do whenever a disciple or elder is ascending.

Also, some swordsmen from the Celestial Conclave alliance, of which Sonox is part, were there to send their friend off. It had already been in their plans that one day, when they were ready, they wouldn’t hesitate to ascend.
Their aim was, of course, a Great High world. However, most end up ascending to a Legacy High world and even stay there for as long as they can.
However, they knew Old Sword wasn’t going to a Legacy High world because they knew the kind of person he was.
Though he was ascending to a Legacy High World, they knew his main destination would be a Great High World, for that is where the best treasures and training can be found.
They all came to bid him farewell, as friends or even rivals. However, at the moment, they all are happy for Old Sword, for he had proven the path is not close for any of them.

"I am not going to give any grand speech before I leave, so don’t expect one. However, to all of you who have received my care package, study it well and practice, because, believe it or not, the path forward is what I have given you.
You have time, and with time, you have opportunities. Use this time to improve, and trust me, soon, you will be the one ascending.
I know you will all miss me, but don’t worry; by the time you catch up, I will become an immortal and take you all in as my disciples."
Laughter burst out as everyone laughed at Old Sword’s joke.

"Old Sword, just so you know, I only lost the last duel because I had a backlash in that one skill I used. The next time we meet, I will be sure to defeat you," the Bleeding Sword Emperor, one of Old Sword’s rivals, said with a faint smile.
Old Sword smiled and nodded.

"Old Sword, when you break through to the Spirit Ascension stage and restore your youth, be sure not to look as handsome as you did in your youth. As you already know, when it comes to who is the handsome one, I hold that title," the Serene Wind Sword Emperor also spoke, making everyone shake their heads at his shamelessness.
Soon, more and more people said what they had to say.
"I will be sure to look forward to when you all appear in the worlds out there. Until then, I will be on my way."
The elder in charge of the formation ascension platform activated the formation, causing a green light to illuminate the entire platform.
Old Sword smiled and began walking toward the formation. After taking a few steps, he paused and turned back, facing Kent, who stood somewhere at the back.
He nodded calmly at Kent, and Kent nodded back.
"Until next time..." With that, Old Sword stepped into the formation, and the next second, his body vanished.

chapters.title: Chapter 891: Chasing After Nirvana Body
paragraphs: After Old Sword ascended, everyone slowly left, with Kent returning to Lady Enzi’s abode.
She was also there to bid him farewell, so they went back together.
"I should also prepare and ascend. The moment my disciple gains a good grip on the glass element, I will prepare and ascend," Lady Enzi said with a distant expression.
Though they aren’t best friends, he and Old Sword are on good terms. So his leaving seems to have affected her somehow.

Kent looked at her and smiled. "Your time will come, big sister. But don’t forget, you said you would only ascend after breaking eight limits. You are two limits short, so perhaps let’s focus on that first."
Lady Enzi shrugged and said, "Old Sword only broke six, but he had ascended."
"Well, he had comprehended Intent Solidification, so I can boldly say he had reached the point to ascend. You, on the other hand, are still lacking."
Lady Enzi glared at Kent, then an evil smile appeared on her face. "If I am lacking, why don’t we spar and see who will be eating sand?"
Kent smiled and shook his head. "Sorry to burst your bubble, big sister, but as it happens, I am not the same person I was a few weeks ago.
I have reached the stage where I can wipe the floor with you and make it on time for breakfast." Kent leaked a sliver of his aura, causing Lady Enzi to raise her brow.
"You... How?" She could sense that if Kent unleashed his entire aura, she would pass out. The bloodlust she felt was one she had never felt before, yet she knew it was beyond her.
Kent smiled and waved his hand, sending both himself and Lady Enzi into the Body Tower.
"No need to look shocked, big sister. When it comes to who the true predator is, you are looking at him. That said, since you are my sister, I will be sure to help you not fall behind."
Kent pointed at the Golden Titan Stairway. "That is a supreme treasure that will aid you in your body cultivation journey just by climbing.

You are already a Diamond Body, so reaching the Sage stage is only a matter of time. Even so, start from the first step, for every 100 steps climbed comes with a reward you wouldn’t want to miss out on.
It might even help you break more limits on your body.
Reaching the Nirvana Body cultivation stage will demand more, but I have yet to reach that stage, so perhaps after reaching the Sage stage, you can focus on your foundation.
There is a place for that, too. You will be taken there when you reach the Sage body stage and have climbed to the 1,200th step."
Lady Enzi nodded, already aware of the heaven-defying treasures Kent owned.
"You can start now, and since twenty-four hours here is an hour outside, you should be done in a month. That will be a day and a few hours on the outside."
The two of them started climbing the stairs, with Kent merely running through since he had already reached the 300th step.
Soon, time quickly passed.
Kent had already reached the 1,900th step and was seated there, not because he was tired or because he couldn’t climb. He wasn’t feeling anything to the point that he had to sit and examine his body.

At first, he couldn’t do that, but now that he had access to his Soul Sea, he could see inside his body, and now that he was looking at his bones, he couldn’t help but wonder what was happening to him.
On all his bones were three sets of runes: green, gold, and red.
He didn’t know where the green came from, but he knew the golden runes came from the various tempering treasures the Stairway was giving him.
He sensed the power of Metal and Divinity from the golden-colored runes. They were tiny, and there were hundreds of them.
As for the red runes, Kent knew they came from his bloodline and the cultivation path he had chosen. He could sense the primal and chaotic aura oozing from them.
"At this rate, my bones will become several times stronger than anyone my cultivation base should have," he smiled. "But then they are not the primordial Chaos Dragon, so they can run and hide."
He drank the elixir given to him by the Stairway and started to climb. Soon, he was only a step away from the 1,200th step, one that only Zaila had reached.
When he stepped on it, he sensed the pressure bearing down on him, telling him that from here onwards, he would have to put in the work.

Kent contemplated continuing to climb, and after a few internal struggles, he chose to continue. He had other things to handle, but strengthening his body and attaining the Nirvana Body were also important.
When he stepped on the 1,201st step, he started feeling the pressure, but Kent wasn’t at his limit, so he quickly continued to climb.
Seven days passed, and Kent managed to climb to the 1,500th step.
He looked at the thousands of steps leading up and sighed. "I probably won’t be able to reach the 10,002 anytime soon."

Reaching the 10,002 would indeed make him someone whose physique could rival and even surpass Titans. However, to reach that level, he must do more than climb. He had to temper his body several times.

He already has a cultivation technique that would make him a deadly predator, and if he managed to claim the Primal Body Tempering Art, he would become even more monstrous. However, none of it was simple.
It would require great dedication and suffering to reach the level where he could beat his chest and say, when it comes to body cultivation, not even the God of Body Cultivation can rival me.
Kent sighed and continued to climb with renewed determination.
Meanwhile, Lady Enzi had managed to reach the 1,900th step and was now cultivating the elixir given to her.
Kent estimated she would reach the Sage Body stage when she reached the 1,200th step, but it seemed she was much closer to that stage than he expected.
A few hours after she took the elixir, she broke through. This brought a wave of happiness; she never knew she was capable of feeling.
With the strength she had earned, she chose to reach the 1,200th step.
Her disciple was in seclusion so she could be away from the outside world for at least three months. This was why she planned to use the time difference to train inside the tower before going back.
After reaching the 1,200th step, she was taken away and sent to the part of the tower where the Realm Enlightenment tablet was.

The moment she appeared there, she sensed her glass realm react deeply with the tablet, and before she knew it, she entered an enlightenment that would shape her view on the glass realm, one that she would forever be thankful to Kent for.
Meanwhile, Kent was nearing the 2,000th step after spending three weeks on the stairway. He had become a Sage Body and was aiming for the Nirvana Body before getting back to other things.
Three days later, Kent raised his right leg and stepped on the 2,000th step.
The moment he stepped on the 2,000th step, a flame appeared on his forehead, and before long, Kent’s body was reduced to nothing, leaving only a triangular-shaped golden-red crystal behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 892: Attaining Nirvana Body
paragraphs: If there is one thing every dedicated Body cultivator chases after and, to some degree, lusts after, then it is Nirvana Body.

A body forged from the flames of Nirvana is one that no Body cultivator would reject. Legends even say that bodies forged from the flames of Nirvana can live for hundreds of thousands of years, even if the spirit is dead.
Naturally, this isn’t much if one puts the natural lifespan from cultivation into consideration.
Hundreds of thousands of years, to some cultivators, isn’t much, for there are immortals who have been alive for a million years.
However, this unique ability of the Nirvana Body is one that only true cultivators understand its value.
Those who truly chase after the Daos (Laws) know that the laws are more visible in the underworld. Naturally, to get to the underworld, one must die.
The underworld is the realm of the dead.
However, just like there are loopholes in computer programs, getting to the underworld also has loopholes, and one of them is using soul bodies.
But there is a downside to this method.

Once there, your body outside the underworld will be vulnerable, and if not returned within a couple of thousand years, it might become worthless. The moment that happens, the spirit will be forever trapped in the underworld.
The body in the world of the living is the only tether the soul has, so the moment it decays, that tether will be severed and the soul will be trapped in the underworld for good.
However, there is a fix, and that is where the Nirvana Body comes in.
This body can remain protected for many years, allowing one to chase and comprehend the Dao in the underworld without fear of their body giving up on them.
Many go on to become gods without attaining the Nirvana Body. However, a true cultivator knows that to get the best out of cultivation, one must attain Nirvana.
Kent’s Mortal Body was burnt away, and his Nirvana Body was slowly forming.
Once complete, not only would he become several times stronger, but he would also be recognized by the Flames of Nirvana.
This means if he wishes to take the Body Refining Path before focusing on attaining Immortal body, burning his body twelve times to attain the Everlasting Nirvana Body, is now within his grasp.
Though the success rate of that path is very low.
[Everlasting Nirvana Council – Somewhere in the Dip (A Ruin from the Primordial Era)]
During the Primordial Era, the Dip used to be one of the nine places in the mortal realm where the flames of Nirvana could be found.
Back then, many used those flames to temper their bodies, extending their lifespans. It was one of the many places that always had cultivators, no matter the time of day.
When the Primordial was destroyed, the eight other places with the flames of Nirvana were lost. Only the Dip was found many millions of years ago.

When it was discovered that the flame it was housing was a Nirvana Flame, the predators of the Body Cultivation Path and a few other tyrants formed a council and chose to monopolize it, preventing many from using it.
Even the Supreme Celestial is part of this council, and for billions of years now, this group of cultivators has benefited from this Nirvana flame.
However, at the moment, the fourteen original members of the council were alarmed to see the Nirvana Pool drying up.
It was as if their treasure was dying before their eyes, and despite their strength and authority, none was able to do anything to stop it.
"How is this even possible?" a Celestial with red eyes and four black horns asked, looking at the pool that was quickly drying up.
The shock was too great that, aside from the Celestial who spoke, the rest merely stood there, staring at the place where the blue-colored flame of Nirvana used to burn.
After who knows how long, all fourteen members of the Nirvana Council unleashed their cultivations, each with a pained and angry look on their faces.
With their cultivations, they knew the pool hadn’t dried up naturally. They knew it was done by someone, and that pissed them off.
They wanted to get their hands on the person who dared steal what belonged to them.
If only they knew the owner of the flames of Nirvana had merely taken back what he gave to the universe many years ago.
In eight different places, eight different colored flames dried up just like the one the Nirvana Council had been using to cultivate for many years.
Back inside the tower, the golden-red triangular-shaped crystal shuddered, and out of nowhere, nine different colored flames started entering it.
If the Nirvana Council were around now and watching this display, they would be vomiting blood.

The idea that something they had depended on for many years was being absorbed by a mere Core Formation Stage kid— they would even destroy the entire world he was in and go ahead to kill everybody who ever saw Kent as compensation for their loss.
However, as it stands, all nine parts of the Nirvana Flames in the universe were being devoured by Kent’s Source Heart.
After what felt like forever, the last strand of Nirvana Flame entered Kent’s Source Heart.
After that, a golden transparent light formed into a cocoon around the Source Heart and soon solidified into a golden cocoon pulsing with energy.
It took forty-five good days, but on this day, the cocoon cracked and a handsome young man was revealed. Kent’s body appeared, surrounded by a wave of primal aura.
He maintained the same appearance. However, his features had sharpened, making him appear both handsome and, well, dangerous.
The aura around him was several times stronger than before he attained Nirvana.
This meant that, aside from his Primordial Chaos Aura, which made him a monster unlike any other, he had now become several times more monstrous with a Nirvana Body.
When he opened his eyes, nine different colors flashed across his pupils. Clothes covered his body, and Kent stood up.
He flexed his body for a few seconds, then a smile appeared on his face. "Looks like I should go to the Valley of Torture again."
He could feel his body was now many times stronger than before.
"Tower, what has changed about me?" Kent asked.
⟦Aside from the master becoming even more handsome, his strength is now three times what it was before he attained the Nirvana Body.
Aside from that, the master has also attained Super Flame Resistance and Super Flame Comprehension.
Also, the Master’s Chaos Soul Flame has reached Tier 9 and now possesses some powers of the nine elemental Nirvana Flames.
The master has also formed 1,000 Flame Veins.
The last thing is the Nirvana Flame Armor that has already started merging with the master’s body. It is estimated to be complete within 200 days (Outside Time).⟧
Kent laughed happily and looked at the 8,002 steps still left for him to climb. After a few moments, he smiled and flew away from the stairway.
"I have many things to handle, so I will come back later. Next time, I will climb to the top of the stairway to attain an Immortal Body. That is now the target I am looking forward to."

⟦The master must know that attaining an Immortal Body is only possible if the master can handle Immortal Aura, so perhaps the master should chase after the twelve stages of Nirvana and attain the Everlasting Nirvana Body.⟧
"Then I will do that. But first, I must learn the Primal Body Tempering Art."
Kent appeared inside the sword tower and immediately went into a lotus posture. Soon, his consciousness was pulled back into the Realm of Blood and Chaos, appearing before the colossal gate.

sentences.text: If there is one thing every dedicated Body cultivator chases after and, to some degree, lusts after, then it is Nirvana Body.
A body forged from the flames of Nirvana is one that no Body cultivator would reject.
Legends even say that bodies forged from the flames of Nirvana can live for hundreds of thousands of years, even if the spirit is dead.
Naturally, this isn’t much if one puts the natural lifespan from cultivation into consideration.
Hundreds of thousands of years, to some cultivators, isn’t much, for there are immortals who have been alive for a million years.
However, this unique ability of the Nirvana Body is one that only true cultivators understand its value.
Those who truly chase after the Daos (Laws) know that the laws are more visible in the underworld.
Naturally, to get to the underworld, one must die.
The underworld is the realm of the dead.
However, just like there are loopholes in computer programs, getting to the underworld also has loopholes, and one of them is using soul bodies.
But there is a downside to this method.
Once there, your body outside the underworld will be vulnerable, and if not returned within a couple of thousand years, it might become worthless.
The moment that happens, the spirit will be forever trapped in the underworld.
The body in the world of the living is the only tether the soul has, so the moment it decays, that tether will be severed and the soul will be trapped in the underworld for good.
However, there is a fix, and that is where the Nirvana Body comes in.
This body can remain protected for many years, allowing one to chase and comprehend the Dao in the underworld without fear of their body giving up on them.
Many go on to become gods without attaining the Nirvana Body.
However, a true cultivator knows that to get the best out of cultivation, one must attain Nirvana.
Kent’s Mortal Body was burnt away, and his Nirvana Body was slowly forming.
Once complete, not only would he become several times stronger, but he would also be recognized by the Flames of Nirvana.
This means if he wishes to take the Body Refining Path before focusing on attaining Immortal body, burning his body twelve times to attain the Everlasting Nirvana Body, is now within his grasp.

chapters.title: Chapter 893: Blood Aura
paragraphs: BOOM
The first thing that happened the moment Kent arrived in the realm of blood and chaos was a loud explosion that shook the very sea.
The blood-red sea churned violently, sending ripples that carried a powerful shockwave all around. Kent had to create a red barrier around his body.
Even with his Nirvana body, he barely managed to resist the pressure.
However, no matter the pressure, he only moved back a couple of steps.
Suddenly, from the bottom of the sea, a large, red, and terrifying tome rose, splitting the sea. It appeared with the power of blood oozing from it.
Kent moved a couple more steps back until his back was pressed against the large door.
"Blood Aura," Kent looked at the large time and read the title written in an ancient language that, somehow, he understood.
He looked below, and after a couple of reads, a smile appeared on his face.
"In your face, Chaos. The Blood Aura you so very much wanted me to suffer for has just revealed itself to me. The next time we meet, I will be sure to rub it in your face."
Kent laughed.
Bhaal told him that after learning the Primal Core Formation Diagram, if he somehow managed to form his core, obtaining things that belonged to the Slaughter King wouldn’t be too hard.
He didn’t say it would be easy; he only said it wouldn’t be too difficult. At the moment, Kent knew that he wouldn’t be swimming to the bottom of the ocean for a mere technique.
It has revealed itself, and so he was only left with the learning aspect.

He flew into the air and slowly approached the tome, which was oozing a rather potent blood energy. After coming within two meters of it, Kent couldn’t approach any closer, or he would risk passing out.
However, he was also within the acceptable distance to learn the technique since he could already sense the tome calling for him to enter the technique space.
He accepted the call, and for a moment, the space around him turned white; then, he was enveloped by a blinding red light filled with blood and carnage.
"What in the hell?" Kent appeared in a red world. Everything about the world was red. However, that wasn’t the most striking thing he saw.
Standing inside this red space was a large black statue of a man he knew all too well. It was Bhaal’Khar, the Slaughter King, one of the six true Primordials.
The statue was about 70 km tall, and Kent, who appeared tiny in front of this statue, was hovering several kilometers away from its face.
Suddenly, the eyes on the statue opened red, revealing a powerful killing intent that took hold of Kent. He couldn’t even feel his own body as the killing intent overwhelmed him.
"Weak."

Bhaal’s arrogant voice spoke through the mouth of the statue, which did not open but was heard by Kent. If it were to open, Kent would probably lose control of his body and might crash into the ground, dying.
But even so, the voice that spoke shook him.
Although it was Bhaal’s voice, Kent didn’t sense the friendliness from him like he did when he was obtaining the Primal Core Formation Diagram.

"As a true primordial, you should have an aura that can easily kill those four or five realms above you. However, looking at you now, I can boldly say aside from knocking someone in the same realm as you out, you wouldn’t be able to do much anymore."
"And whose fault is that?" Kent smirked, though he was still scared like a baby. "I only managed to obtain the Primal Core Formation Diagram a couple of weeks ago out of sheer luck.
Had it not been for luck, I would have ended up using the weak method to form my core. So tell me, Bhaal’Khar, why was that?"
There was a pause, and then Bhaal sneered, "Don’t use the Primal Core Formation Diagram as an excuse. You are the primordial Chaos Dragon.
Even without the Primal Core Formation Diagram, you were supposed to have a much stronger aura than the weak one you have on you at the moment.

However, aside from this weak and useless aura that can’t even kill a fly, all you have are excuses. I sensed you when you first entered my Blood Realm. Compared to you now, I have to say, you are a disappointment."
For some reason, Kent didn’t like being looked down on by this man. However, he was also powerless to do anything.
’Bastard.’
Knowing he would hear him, Kent went ahead and let out his frustration.
"Are you going to teach me the technique or should I just leave?" Kent asked with a frown, but Bhaal said nothing. After a five-minute wait, Kent sighed.
"I promise I won’t be such a disappointment when we meet in the future."
Bhaal chuckled as if he wasn’t bothered. "Just so you know, this statue of me was when I was a mere Spirit King, just two realms above your current level.
However, at that stage, with this aura you are feeling, Spirit Kings and Sovereigns were insects before me.
The Blood Aura isn’t one that can be cultivated while seated in a lotus posture. It demands slaughter — the more you kill, the stronger it gets.
It is a perfect match for the Primal Body Tempering Art, so listen to my advice and slaughter more, for that is the only way you will one day reach the point where nobody can threaten you."
"I will be sure to remember your kind words."
Bhaal, in his statue form, didn’t say anything; however, a light flew from the forehead of the statue and entered Kent’s forehead.
"It will be ideal to slaughter realms above you. Also, only temper your body with the blood of beasts. I recommend demonic beasts since they have a much more tyrannical presence and chaotic bloods..
That said, every kill counts, so when it is just, go for the kill.

Also, when you are outmatched, find a way to escape, train even more, and come back to kill every last one of them. That is the path of Slaughter, and as the best of us True Primordials, you must learn that early."
"Thank you for your wise words. I will be sure to walk that path of slaughter like how it was meant to be walked."
A wave of cold air blew over Kent’s body, and he was back in the Realm of Blood.
The giant terrifying tome dispersed into a spark of red light and flew into the mark that appeared on Kent’s forehead.
The moment the last light entered Kent’s body, a powerful blood aura burst from his body, sending a wave of primal blood aura shooting far and wide.
He fell into a weird state for a few moments before he regained his senses. When he did, his eyes turned red, and a wave of red mist flew from them.
In that moment, anyone with a weak heart and resolve would collapse if they were to stare Kent in the eye.
However, it got even worse when he turned into his demi-dragon form. His claw now had a red aura coating it, radiating an aura that could cut through anything.
A smile appeared on his face, "We are back in Business."

chapters.title: Chapter 894: The Primal Body Tempering Art
paragraphs: After obtaining the Blood Aura technique and learning it, Kent’s next focus was on merging it with the Claw Aura.
However, in order to do that, he had to go through Chaos’s memories, which he had scribbled on the large door bounded by the thick chain.
Though he had the Primal Core Formation Diagram, which was technically Bhaal’s approval to obtain everything he owned, he still had to break the chain to acquire the Primal Body Tempering art.
But according to Chaos, merging the Claw Aura with the Blood Aura, forming the Blood Claw Aura, is the only way he would be able to break the chain.
So Kent delved deeply into reading every last thing Chaos wrote. By the time he was done, it was as if he were the one who had written them.
They became a part of him, just like whenever he finished reading a Memory diary.
"Though he is hateful sometimes, he did indeed create something very great. However, now that I am here, I will make it even more grand."
Kent waved his hand, and his claws glowed red, showing he had activated the Blood Aura.
The energy emanating from it brought a smile to his face.
However, he went ahead and activated the second aura, the Chaos Claw Aura, which had a hue of purple gold.
It slowly began to fuse with the Blood Aura.
"This will take some time, but while that happens..."
Kent extended his left clawed hand, and his claws were coated by another Blood Aura again. However, instead of activating the Claw Aura, he activated his Sword Aura.
The moment the two came together, a ripple spread out, cutting the air with gentle yet metallic whispers.
"The only reason Chaos needed almost a year to form the Blood Chaos Aura was that he was merely trying to balance only one aura with the Blood Aura.
Because the Blood Aura is so powerful, balancing the merge with only one aura is not an easy task. However, I have an additional aura that is also strong.
This means that, aside from forming the Blood Chaos Claw Aura, I will also be forming the Blood Sword Aura."
A wicked smile appeared on Kent’s lips. This was where he would surpass Chaos. The outcome of this merger will take his strength to a whole new level.
"Thanks to Jest, who experimented with both Sword and Spear Aura, I know walking the orthodox path of Sword Aura is not recommended.
If you hit a roadblock with one aura, making progress with the other would be impossible," Kent laughed, watching as the processes happening in both hands slowly progressed.
"But, in my case, the Blood Aura is already comparable to a Heavenly Sword Aura, meaning for now, I don’t even have to worry about it.

However, even if one day I hit a roadblock in my Blood Aura, all I have to do is kill and extract the blood essence of my kills and use it to temper my body, or simply break through to the next stage, and my Blood Aura will naturally progress.

As for my Chaos Claw Aura, the more access I have to my bloodline, the stronger it gets. Basically, the only thing I should be worried about now is my Sword Aura, which, for that, I have to cultivate every step of the way.
However, who am I if not the greatest swordsman to have ever lived?"
If anyone deserves to brag, then it is indeed Kent, who lived as the Primordial Chaos Dragon that once dominated the Primordial Era.
He had also lived as Lord Genesis, the greatest swordsman to have ever lived. But if that wasn’t enough, he came back again, and this time, he became the Faceless Assassin, one without a face.
Basically, he had done enough, yet he was again doing more than was required of him, and that alone makes him someone to be feared.
A day went by, but the process was only a quarter done. From Kent’s estimation, it would take at least five days, so he was prepared for it.
But in the meantime, Kent was already working on theories he planned to explore next.
"Since the Blood Aura is linked to my cultivation, I can forever use that as the base aura for any future merges. However, to form the next merge, I need three more auras.
Once I form two more mergers, I will have four dual auras under my command, meaning I can merge them too to form two quadruple auras.

Now, if I manage to achieve that, the limit I will chase next will be eight aura combinations until I hit 64 auras. That would be the minimum limit that I, Kent Madson, will reach before I become a god."
Kent’s blood boiled, and for a moment, a mysterious light shone in his eyes.
Five days later, Kent smiled, seeing the uniform combinations he had formed and currently swirling in both hands.
The Blood Aura dominated both appearances. The major color for both the Blood Claw Aura and the Blood Sword Aura is red. However, the other auras also have their colors noticeable in them.
The Blood Chaos Claw Aura has that red-purplish hue, and the Blood Sword Aura has the red-golden hue.
Kent looked at the chain binding the door and smirked. He could sense it; his claw had become so powerful that the thick and unbreakable chain now appeared like a mere rope before him.
It felt weird, but Kent could see the chain and knew he could easily break it.
He flew into the air and hovered two meters away from the chain. He looked at the claw with a focused gaze for a moment before he took a powerful swing at the chain.
Five powerful crescent red-purplish arcs appeared.
The void that Kent hadn’t been able to tear before using his hand was torn as the five arcs moved very quickly toward the thick, dark chains.

The arcs cut through the air with a sharp, metallic hiss, glowing fiercely as they sped toward the chains. Upon impact, the chains were cut like paper, and the attack slammed into the door, swinging it open.
Kent backed away due to the powerful force that pushed him back.
"I now understand why Chaos said he wouldn’t use the Blood Chaos Claw Aura again until he becomes an immortal. It turns out a weaker body wouldn’t be able to use it."
Kent smiled, "Me, on the other hand, had already achieved Nirvana and reformed my body using the flames of Nirvana. Meaning I have met all the requirements to use it."

He turned and looked at the red sea behind him, feeling the need to raise a middle finger at it. However, knowing he had earned so much this time, he bowed slightly toward it and walked through the door, opening his eyes to the outside.
A thick red tome, similar to the one from which he learned the Claw Aura, appeared from Kent’s forehead the moment he opened his eyes outside.
However, this time, instead of making him enter the technique space, the tome turned into nine red runes. They flew and entered his forehead.
The moment they entered his forehead, nine waves of energy exploded from Kent’s body in rapid succession.
Kent formed a hand seal the moment the ninth wave erupted from his body. From his forehead, a rune appeared and entered his chest.

Kent’s body shuddered, then he fell into a trancelike state, entering the realm of Enlightenment. He wouldn’t be waking up for a couple of months, considering where he went wasn’t a place a person can come back from within weeks.

sentences.text: After obtaining the Blood Aura technique and learning it, Kent’s next focus was on merging it with the Claw Aura.
However, in order to do that, he had to go through Chaos’s memories, which he had scribbled on the large door bounded by the thick chain.
Though he had the Primal Core Formation Diagram, which was technically Bhaal’s approval to obtain everything he owned, he still had to break the chain to acquire the Primal Body Tempering art.
But according to Chaos, merging the Claw Aura with the Blood Aura, forming the Blood Claw Aura, is the only way he would be able to break the chain.
So Kent delved deeply into reading every last thing Chaos wrote.
By the time he was done, it was as if he were the one who had written them.
They became a part of him, just like whenever he finished reading a Memory diary.
"Though he is hateful sometimes, he did indeed create something very great.
However, now that I am here, I will make it even more grand."
Kent waved his hand, and his claws glowed red, showing he had activated the Blood Aura.
The energy emanating from it brought a smile to his face.
However, he went ahead and activated the second aura, the Chaos Claw Aura, which had a hue of purple gold.
It slowly began to fuse with the Blood Aura.
"This will take some time, but while that happens..."
Kent extended his left clawed hand, and his claws were coated by another Blood Aura again.
However, instead of activating the Claw Aura, he activated his Sword Aura.
The moment the two came together, a ripple spread out, cutting the air with gentle yet metallic whispers.
"The only reason Chaos needed almost a year to form the Blood Chaos Aura was that he was merely trying to balance only one aura with the Blood Aura.
Because the Blood Aura is so powerful, balancing the merge with only one aura is not an easy task.
However, I have an additional aura that is also strong.
This means that, aside from forming the Blood Chaos Claw Aura, I will also be forming the Blood Sword Aura."
A wicked smile appeared on Kent’s lips.
This was where he would surpass Chaos.
The outcome of this merger will take his strength to a whole new level.
"Thanks to Jest, who experimented with both Sword and Spear Aura, I know walking the orthodox path of Sword Aura is not recommended.
If you hit a roadblock with one aura, making progress with the other would be impossible," Kent laughed, watching as the processes happening in both hands slowly progressed.
"But, in my case, the Blood Aura is already comparable to a Heavenly Sword Aura, meaning for now, I don’t even have to worry about it.

However, even if one day I hit a roadblock in my Blood Aura, all I have to do is kill and extract the blood essence of my kills and use it to temper my body, or simply break through to the next stage, and my Blood Aura will naturally progress.
As for my Chaos Claw Aura, the more access I have to my bloodline, the stronger it gets.
Basically, the only thing I should be worried about now is my Sword Aura, which, for that, I have to cultivate every step of the way.
However, who am I if not the greatest swordsman to have ever lived?"
If anyone deserves to brag, then it is indeed Kent, who lived as the Primordial Chaos Dragon that once dominated the Primordial Era.
He had also lived as Lord Genesis, the greatest swordsman to have ever lived.
But if that wasn’t enough, he came back again, and this time, he became the Faceless Assassin, one without a face.
Basically, he had done enough, yet he was again doing more than was required of him, and that alone makes him someone to be feared.
A day went by, but the process was only a quarter done.
From Kent’s estimation, it would take at least five days, so he was prepared for it.
But in the meantime, Kent was already working on theories he planned to explore next.
"Since the Blood Aura is linked to my cultivation, I can forever use that as the base aura for any future merges.
However, to form the next merge, I need three more auras.
Once I form two more mergers, I will have four dual auras under my command, meaning I can merge them too to form two quadruple auras.
Now, if I manage to achieve that, the limit I will chase next will be eight aura combinations until I hit 64 auras.
That would be the minimum limit that I, Kent Madson, will reach before I become a god."
Kent’s blood boiled, and for a moment, a mysterious light shone in his eyes.
Five days later, Kent smiled, seeing the uniform combinations he had formed and currently swirling in both hands.
The Blood Aura dominated both appearances.
The major color for both the Blood Claw Aura and the Blood Sword Aura is red.
However, the other auras also have their colors noticeable in them.
The Blood Chaos Claw Aura has that red-purplish hue, and the Blood Sword Aura has the red-golden hue.
Kent looked at the chain binding the door and smirked.
He could sense it; his claw had become so powerful that the thick and unbreakable chain now appeared like a mere rope before him.
It felt weird, but Kent could see the chain and knew he could easily break it.
He flew into the air and hovered two meters away from the chain.
He looked at the claw with a focused gaze for a moment before he took a powerful swing at the chain.
Five powerful crescent red-purplish arcs appeared.
The void that Kent hadn’t been able to tear before using his hand was torn as the five arcs moved very quickly toward the thick, dark chains.
The arcs cut through the air with a sharp, metallic hiss, glowing fiercely as they sped toward the chains.
Upon impact, the chains were cut like paper, and the attack slammed into the door, swinging it open.
Kent backed away due to the powerful force that pushed him back.
"I now understand why Chaos said he wouldn’t use the Blood Chaos Claw Aura again until he becomes an immortal.
It turns out a weaker body wouldn’t be able to use it."
Kent smiled, "Me, on the other hand, had already achieved Nirvana and reformed my body using the flames of Nirvana.
Meaning I have met all the requirements to use it."
