chapters.title: Chapter 895: World Emergency
paragraphs: [Two Months Later - Outside Time]
It had already been two months on the outside since Kent fell into the blood enlightenment state.
Life was going on as usual.
First, Lady Enzi had achieved so much that the moment she came out of the tower, the urge to ascend immediately came to her mind.

Not only had she reached the Sage Body cultivation stage, but she had also broken her 7th limit, which, strangely, was on her soul, giving her so much power that even she didn’t know was possible to have that much strength at the Core Formation stage.
Aside from that, she also gained Glass Dao enlightenment, expanding her understanding of the glass element, which allowed her to better her Glass Realm.
It was a known fact that gaining enlightenment was something that could push one’s understanding of whatever they had gained enlightenment on by several folds.
This time, her understanding of her glass element had expanded, and that gave her the confidence that she could survive in a Great High World.

However, she found out Kent had yet to come out, so she chose to handle other matters, like making sure her disciple, who had also made tremendous progress, gained more understanding now that she had also achieved this much insight.
Safe to say that when Kent comes out of the tower, she will thank him greatly.

Aside from her, Lady Liora had also made progress with her disciple. Thanks to the Pill Princess, now reverting back to how she should have been in the first place, Lady Liora finally managed to impart the techniques she wanted to give her.
This meant she was also ready to ascend, considering she had nothing left to teach her disciple. Of course, she can choose to stay here for a few more years and further guide her disciple.
However, she wanted to go back to her world to handle some issues troubling her over the past months.
But just like Lady Enzi, she was also waiting for Kent to come out before she would leave.

As for Kent’s little sister, Nyss, she had also come out a few times to see if Kent was around, but after finding out he was in seclusion, she stopped coming and instead focused on mastering the skills Kent gave her.
But all in all, life in the sect was good.
However, back in Sonox, a danger was looming over the world.
A couple of months before coming to the sect, Kent sent a message to the Hand through the leader of the Oracles.
The message was delivered well.
However, they disregarded it, and so when Kent came to Elarion, they came after him again, and that was when he made sure they understood what real terror looks like.
However, while Kent managed to send a rather brutal message this time, that escalation was a recipe for disaster that even Kent didn’t see coming.
Not that he could have predicted the Hand would have such a plot in mind. It was safe to say she was indeed a schemer, one who put a lot of thought into her plans.
When the mysterious face that appeared in the mirror told her to use the Ancient Vampire race in her plot, she accepted that outcome.

But she didn’t immediately go to them, for she knew that even at her strength, which she had managed to recover a few weeks ago, entering the Death Region was like throwing her defenseless body to a pack of wolves.
So she waited and instead focused on finding the keys of the Apocalypse.
Seven days ago, the last of the Seven Keys of the Apocalypse was found.
The moment the Keys were found, the sky turned gloomy, for the inevitable was finally upon everyone. Kent knew of this, for he had been waiting for this very moment to arrive.
It was his destiny to experience the apocalypses, after all.
But yet again, what happened next shook everyone days later.

While everyone was going about their lives, the Sea Race was colluding with the Hand to do something very bad. In fact, this bad thing was something not even Lord Leviathan was aware of, for it went against everything he stood for.

He may be arrogant and even unreasonable most of the time; however, he never once goes to extreme lengths, such as catching all those who possess the bloodline of the Wynthralls—the same bloodline flowing through Elaine’s body—and offering them as a bargaining chip to the Ancient Cursed Vampire Race.
Nobody saw that coming. However sinister this plot was something that had been in the works for years now.
It all started 13,000 years ago when the Hand found out a very important secret that had been kept under wraps for a very long time.
It turns out the Ancient Vampire race isn’t as simple as one might expect.
Their lineage came from a very dangerous force in this universe that nobody wanted to mess with, especially during the Evil Era: the Forsaken Race.
They are a race of powerful beings that have been forsaken by the universe. They don’t have a root, for their root has been wiped from existence.
Legend has it that they came about due to an unholy union between the Doom Race, who evaded the universe and were the cause of the fall of the Primordial era.
These forsaken races are dangerous, for they are the only beings in the entire universe who aren’t affected by the restrictions on worlds.
This means they can go anywhere they want, and their cultivation wouldn’t be affected in any way.
Thankfully, there was a restriction on them. Because of this restriction, they cannot leave their worlds.
However, just like everything, there is a loophole, and this loophole was the Ancient Vampire Race.
It was said that whenever a Vampire race is cursed, their bloodline calls to the Forsaken Race.

The Hand somehow found out this secret, and so while Kent was looking forward to the Apocalyptic Race to emerge, a sinister deal was instead made between the Hand, the Sea Race, and the Vampire race, who happened to be a cursed race.
This unholy alliance resulted in 7,508,000 beings having the blood of the Wynthralls being sacrificed, and the barrier that was keeping the Vampire Race contained came down.
A battle that was supposed to be between the Sea Race and the Vampires was now directed toward the Elves, Dragons, and the other races.
[One Hour Before The Apocalypse - Supreme Immortal Sect - Sect Leader Deimos POV]

Just like Lady Enzi and Lady Liora, the sect master, who had also received Kent’s generosity, was hard at work for months. Three days ago, he managed to breach the 8th limit on his body and was now ready to ascend.
However, just as he was making up his mind, preparing what he must do and where to go, a signal was lit.
"The seal is broken," he said as he vanished, appearing in the core sect. With a wave of his hand, bells started ringing, signalling everyone to come out.
"All disciples should assemble. Our world is under attack." Within minutes, every last disciple was gathered in the three main sections of the sect.
"Sect Elders, initiate the Doomsday Formation."
[One Hour Before The Apocalypse - Elarion - Uncle Drake’s POV]

Uncle Drake, who went to spend some weeks in Elder Lance’s world, came back a week ago and entered seclusion. He gained some insight into his cultivation during his time away, so he went into seclusion to digest it.
However, just as he was making headway, something sinister spread over the world, causing his expression to change.
He vanished and appeared in the throne room where the Elven King was having a meeting with the Dwarven King.
"Alert the rest of the world. We are under attack."

chapters.title: Chapter 896: The Hand Struck Back
paragraphs: [The Hand Headquarters - Amix and the Mirror Woman - Two hours before the Apocalypse]
Inside the dark room with the mirror, the leader of the Hand, who was referred to as the Hand by everyone, stood before the mirror.
A few seconds later, the unrecognizable face of the beautiful lady with the red horns appeared on it, just like the last time.
"Twice within a year, huh? Why have you called, Amix?" the lady asked, sounding strange.
The Hand, whose real name was Amix, sighed. "Things are ready, Mother. I have already secured the blood of the cursed ones and even managed to trap the Leviathan."
"Good job, my child," the lady smiled. "How about the one called Kent Madson, human?"

An angry look appeared on Amix’s face when she heard the question. It was as if hearing Kent’s name was a bane that ate at her heart and soul. She most definitely would love to kill Kent at all costs.
This sight pleased the woman in the mirror.
"I haven’t heard from him in months now. My sources inside the Supreme Immortal Sect told me he is now a disciple there."
A look of relief seemed to appear on the lady’s face. For a moment, she thought what she had been concerned about was indeed the case.

As someone in a High world, she had heard of Kent. At first, she didn’t put any effort into finding out who this Kent was; however, after weeks, when she heard of Kent appearing on Planet Manelaus, she started to panic, knowing her daughter was in a world nobody knew this mysterious Kent was from.

Again, as someone who couldn’t leave her world, she wasn’t about to send everyone to a medium world knowing a very important mission that, if successful, would not only free her and her people but would also bring them a step closer to freeing all Forsaken clans scattered in the vast universe.
She couldn’t risk sending the whole universe to Sonox.
So she said nothing to anyone, for she didn’t want to compromise her daughter. Now hearing Kent wasn’t around to mess with their plans, she was pleased.
"How about the sacrifice?" the lady asked.
"I have prepared everything. The gate will take an hour to open, so I made sure the Cursed Vampires and the Sea Race will pave the way for your arrival, Mother."
The lady smiled. "You are the weakest among your sisters, Amix; however, you have proven to be the most brilliant of them all. I will be sure to recommend you to the Lord when all this is over."
Amix bowed slightly. "Thank you, Mother."

"Don’t worry about it. However, now that the keys have been found, you can start the ritual. In two hours, we will meet, and after we lay waste to every living creature in that world, we will expand to the other worlds and do the same.
This time, the Forsaken Race will rise again and will bring the entire universe to its knees. After all, the Chaos Dragon won’t be here to save them again."
The lady burst out laughing, her red eyes shining brighter as her evil plan had finally been achieved by Amix.
"See you soon, Mother."
With that, Amix turned away to get started with the ritual that would bring the world to its doom soon. After years of planning, the Forsaken Race was ready to appear again in the universe.
[Elarion]
"My queen, we have received word from the Elven queen. The Sea Race has started their assault," a Half-Elf said, holding a communication crystal in his hand.
"Update the first team, tell them to hurry up. The rest start moving out. Lord Drake had already left a minute ago; he will be reaching there in no time."
Queen Jascia commanded, clad in her battle armor, ready to head out and join the battlefield
King Thalirion was already on his way to help the Elves, who were now allies with them.
[The battlefield]
The Elven kingdom was one of the strongest in the world, so when the Sea Race launched the sudden attack, they were ready.
Uncle Drake had already made the Half-Elves aware of the impending danger, so all kingdoms were alert.
The moment the sea race appeared, the battle began.
Everywhere was on fire.
Leading the charge was Lady Aelith, who had come out of seclusion when she sensed the danger.
She wielded a short sword and was clad in black armour.
"Push them back. Don’t let them break the line," she commanded as she clashed with a Seahorse whose body was covered in metallic armour.
It held no weapon, but every time it moved, a wave of water sharpened to the point that a mere shockwave did more damage to the Elves. Lady Aelith was at the receiving end of this bombardment.
However, as someone who had been in many battles, she wasn’t being pressed. She held a determined look as she dodged and attacked.

All around her, Elven warriors were killing and being killed at a fast pace. However, she understood they were warriors, so she wasn’t looking sad like the Elven warriors who couldn’t help fearing for their own lives.
Watching their friends die wasn’t exactly the ideal sight this early morning.
"There are more coming..." Suddenly, an Elf standing on a tall wall shouted.

Lady Aelith looked at the vast sea, and she could see crab-like beasts coming in the thousands. Her pupils shrank; however, she had no time to focus on that since the Seahorse wasn’t holding back at all
"Deploy countermeasures," she shouted, knowing just a few minutes into the battle she was already deploying one of their trump cards.
"Deploy countermeasures!"
"Deploy countermeasures!"
Shouts echoed in the surroundings as large machines forged by the finest blacksmiths in the Dwarven Kingdom rolled forward.
"Load," an Elven general clad in red armour who was in charge of the machines shouted.
Ammunition made from beast cores was loaded into the machines.
He raised his hand and was about to give the order to open fire when, out of nowhere, a large dragon bathed in flames crashed devastatingly into the thousands of crabs coming from the sea.
"Halt your attacks. Reinforcements have arrived," Uncle Drake spoke, appearing from the void holding a spear bathed in flames.
He used a skill called ’Flame Berserker Dragon’ in killing thousands of sea beasts before making his appearance. When the Elves saw her, they felt their energy rise.
"Leviathan, appear now, else don’t blame me for killing your kin," Uncle Drake’s voice boomed as he appeared over the sea, looking coldly at the thousands of beasts still emerging from the sea.
A few seconds after the declaration, a sea dragon rose from the water and turned into a humanoid form.
"Lord Leviathan won’t appear because he has been trapped. This means, unless you alone can kill all of us, by the end of today, you all will die by our hands."

The water dragon that Kent fought back when he was on his way to the Half-Elf kingdom charged at Uncle Drake, who, instead of blocking his attack, retreated just in time to evade a piercing attack from a trident.
Out of the water, a Manta Ray bathed in lightning appeared. However, he wasn’t alone. Behind him were hundreds of thousands of Manta Rays, each bathed in lightning, that appeared.
The sea dragon merely acted as bait for the real attack. However, Uncle Drake saw it coming, so he dodged.
But the next second, everything turned ugly.
The sea churned, and six more sea beasts — an Anglerfish, a Giant Octopus, a Giant Crab, a Seahorse, a White Shark, and a Dolphin — appeared surrounding Uncle Drake.
Soon, the entire sea was covered by over a million sea beasts.
In an instant, the battle came to a standstill.

The lady burst out laughing, her red eyes shining brighter as her evil plan had finally been achieved by Amix.
"See you soon, Mother."
With that, Amix turned away to get started with the ritual that would bring the world to its doom soon.
After years of planning, the Forsaken Race was ready to appear again in the universe.
[Elarion]
"My queen, we have received word from the Elven queen.
The Sea Race has started their assault," a Half-Elf said, holding a communication crystal in his hand.
"Update the first team, tell them to hurry up.
The rest start moving out.
Lord Drake had already left a minute ago; he will be reaching there in no time."
Queen Jascia commanded, clad in her battle armor, ready to head out and join the battlefield
King Thalirion was already on his way to help the Elves, who were now allies with them.
[The battlefield]
The Elven kingdom was one of the strongest in the world, so when the Sea Race launched the sudden attack, they were ready.
Uncle Drake had already made the Half-Elves aware of the impending danger, so all kingdoms were alert.
The moment the sea race appeared, the battle began.
Everywhere was on fire.
Leading the charge was Lady Aelith, who had come out of seclusion when she sensed the danger.
She wielded a short sword and was clad in black armour.
"Push them back.
Don’t let them break the line," she commanded as she clashed with a Seahorse whose body was covered in metallic armour.
It held no weapon, but every time it moved, a wave of water sharpened to the point that a mere shockwave did more damage to the Elves.
Lady Aelith was at the receiving end of this bombardment.
However, as someone who had been in many battles, she wasn’t being pressed.
She held a determined look as she dodged and attacked.
All around her, Elven warriors were killing and being killed at a fast pace.
However, she understood they were warriors, so she wasn’t looking sad like the Elven warriors who couldn’t help fearing for their own lives.
Watching their friends die wasn’t exactly the ideal sight this early morning.
"There are more coming..." Suddenly, an Elf standing on a tall wall shouted.
Lady Aelith looked at the vast sea, and she could see crab-like beasts coming in the thousands.
Her pupils shrank; however, she had no time to focus on that since the Seahorse wasn’t holding back at all
"Deploy countermeasures," she shouted, knowing just a few minutes into the battle she was already deploying one of their trump cards.
"Deploy countermeasures!"
"Deploy countermeasures!"
Shouts echoed in the surroundings as large machines forged by the finest blacksmiths in the Dwarven Kingdom rolled forward.
"Load," an Elven general clad in red armour who was in charge of the machines shouted.
Ammunition made from beast cores was loaded into the machines.
He raised his hand and was about to give the order to open fire when, out of nowhere, a large dragon bathed in flames crashed devastatingly into the thousands of crabs coming from the sea.
"Halt your attacks.
Reinforcements have arrived," Uncle Drake spoke, appearing from the void holding a spear bathed in flames.
He used a skill called ’Flame Berserker Dragon’ in killing thousands of sea beasts before making his appearance.
When the Elves saw her, they felt their energy rise.
"Leviathan, appear now, else don’t blame me for killing your kin," Uncle Drake’s voice boomed as he appeared over the sea, looking coldly at the thousands of beasts still emerging from the sea.
A few seconds after the declaration, a sea dragon rose from the water and turned into a humanoid form.
"Lord Leviathan won’t appear because he has been trapped.
This means, unless you alone can kill all of us, by the end of today, you all will die by our hands."

The water dragon that Kent fought back when he was on his way to the Half-Elf kingdom charged at Uncle Drake, who, instead of blocking his attack, retreated just in time to evade a piercing attack from a trident.
Out of the water, a Manta Ray bathed in lightning appeared.
However, he wasn’t alone.
Behind him were hundreds of thousands of Manta Rays, each bathed in lightning, that appeared.
The sea dragon merely acted as bait for the real attack.
However, Uncle Drake saw it coming, so he dodged.
But the next second, everything turned ugly.
The sea churned, and six more sea beasts — an Anglerfish, a Giant Octopus, a Giant Crab, a Seahorse, a White Shark, and a Dolphin — appeared surrounding Uncle Drake.
Soon, the entire sea was covered by over a million sea beasts.
In an instant, the battle came to a standstill.

chapters.title: Chapter 897: The Apocalypse (1)
paragraphs: Uncle Drake was surrounded on all sides by seven beasts. The sea Dragon that created the diversion was now standing back, smiling at Uncle Drake.
The seven sea beasts now surrounding Uncle Drake are the seven sea Kings.
Right after Lord Leviathan, they were the strongest in the Sea Race. This meant they had considerable strength, and Uncle Drake, who was surrounded on all sides, knew he was indeed in a bind.

’Breaking through would be hard. But even if I manage to break through, the chances of me shaking them off would be very low. In essence, I need to hold them back and hope the others can hold on until Kent arrives.’
"No need to overthink this, Dragon," the Manta Ray Sea King said with a smile. "Thanks to you injuring Lord Leviathan, we were able to subdue and trap him.

So, while this mission is a risky one, I don’t think you will be able to use him to end things. He won’t be breaking free for another ten thousand years. Meaning, unless he breaks a limit that will multiply his lifespan, he will die in the trapped state.
That said, we know we can’t kill you, but we can hold you back long enough for them to arrive."
Without allowing Uncle Drake to ask a question, he attacked, and the six others also attacked. Uncle Drake was forced to swallow his words, and then he attacked as well.
"What should we do?" one of the Elven generals asked, looking at the million-plus sea beasts staring at them.

The moment the sea beasts moved, they knew they would be overrun in minutes. Initially, when only the seahorses attacked, they managed to hold them back and even killed most of them; however, things are different now.

"Prepare to die," A Crab general shouted, pointing his weapon at the Elves. However, before he could give the command to charge forward, the void cracked, and a large ship appeared, followed by a commanding voice.
"The Shadow Demons have arrived." Standing on the deck of the ship were tens of thousands of shadow demons, each clad in dark armour, wielding short swords, daggers, or crossbows.

The void cracked again, and another ship appeared: "The Flame Demons have arrived." The same process repeated itself a few more times, and soon, all seven demon states had arrived, even including the Dark Elves.
But they aren’t the last to appear, the void cracked again, and three large devices housing thousands of arrows fell from it. They quickly fell and moved toward the centre of the Sea Beast formation.
Thousands of sea beasts moved to intercept. However, before they could reach it, a forcefield exploded from the three devices, and then a commanding voice came from the void: "Explode."
The three devices came to a standstill, then a powerful explosion rocked the sea. In an instant, over a hundred thousand sea beasts were reduced to nothing, the sea below them turning crimson.
"The Dwarves have also arrived." The mechanised ship of the Dwarves appeared, bringing hope to thousands of Elves.
The Dwarves are known for building some of the most powerful weapons for war, so their appearance and show of strength boosted morale, even if only for a moment.
The moment their ships arrived, attacks rang out from the sea as furious sea beasts started attacking the ships.
"Attack!"
However, with their numbers now slightly boosted, the Elves charged forward. The demons were second to charge, and the Half-Elves who had arrived with Uncle Drake also attacked.
A few seconds later, the void cracked again, and the Beast Race also arrived and joined the battle. The dragons, on the other hand, had yet to arrive.
However, with the Elves, Half-Elves, demons, Dwarves, and the Beasts already in combat, the battle was slowly taking shape.
Spells flew through the air with deadly accuracy, chants echoed, and weapons clashed as the chaos of the battle slowly took shape.
Uncle Drake was being held back; however, looking at the seven Sea Kings, one could tell they weren’t having it easy, for they had already sustained multiple wounds.
However, they were holding him back because they knew holding him back was the only chance they had in winning the battle, or at least killing as many as they could.

Twenty minutes into the battle, the dragons also appeared, bringing their power to the fight. However, even so, more and more Sea Beasts kept coming out, making the reinforcements less effective than they were supposed to be.
With warriors like Queen Jascia on the battlefield, the Sea Beasts weren’t having it easy. Yet, thirty minutes into the battle, a crab-like sea beast appeared and held back Queen Jascia.
The same thing repeated itself across the battlefield. The powerhouses of Sonox are being held back by the strongest of the Sea Race.
Thankfully, a select few on the battlefield had received Kent’s generosity, so with them doing the most, the battle was at least not as brutal as it was supposed to be.
"It is like there are endless Sea Beasts. Just where are they coming from?" a dragon asked as he clawed the face of a seahorse, sending it flying back several meters.
Everyone was wondering the same thing, for nobody understood that there were so many sea beasts in the world.

What they didn’t know was that, when it comes to the Sea Race, they have millions of warriors to use in battle, for they hold the biggest stretch of land in the world. The sea is vast, and they have seven kingdoms, each housing millions of sea creatures.
If they didn’t have this many fighters, they might as well just become mere food.
However, regardless of their number, the mission was to kill them, and thus, they were being killed.
But just like how they were being killed, they also weren’t sparing the warriors of Sonox.

"Lord Qilin, can you go help Uncle Drake. He can’t use his powerful attacks for that will hurt our side, and holding back isn’t helping either?" Queen Jascia called out when she saw Uncle Drake wasn’t finding an opening at all.
He was their strongest, and with him held back, the alliance was slowly dying, for the sea beasts just kept coming endlessly.
Lord Qilin looked at the battle happening between Uncle Drake, who held a calm expression, and the seven sea Kings who were wounded in many places.
"I will do my best," Lord Qilin dashed toward the Manta Ray, hoping to catch it unnoticed. However, just when he was about to approach the Manta Ray, a whip came out of nowhere, lashing at him.
He halted, created a barrier, and used it to block the whip.
From thin air, a man clad in green metallic armour with a lion face mask appeared.
"Lion Fang," Lord Qilin said coldly, looking at the man who appeared. He held a lightning whip in his firm grip.

"Long time, Father," Lion Fang, one of the seven Fangs of the Hand, spoke, making Lord Qilin, who usually looked calm and comported himself well, frown as a powerful killing intent burst out of his body.
"You are no son of mine." With a powerful attack, Lord Qilin charged at Lion Fang, who was smiling behind his mask.

He was the eldest son of Lord Qilin, who defected and joined the Hand in their conquest of the world. Lord Qilin tried to kill him once, but Amix, the leader of the Hand, intervened, which resulted in a long battle that ended with Lord Qilin wiping her cultivation base by a few refinement levels.
However, even with that big win, Lord Qilin only wanted one thing, and that was to kill the traitorous son of his who betrayed an entire empire of beasts to side with the enemy.
Their battle soon took shape.
A shadow demon appeared through the shadows and beheaded a sea beast. However, before he could move away, a Manta Ray blasted him with lightning.
Mid-air, a seahorse appeared overhead, aiming a water spear at his chest. With the posture the shadow demon was in, he wouldn’t be able to defend himself.
The water spear stabbed toward his chest. However, just when it was mere inches away, a voice boomed, followed by lightning that blasted the seahorse to ashes.
"Here I come."

chapters.title: Chapter 898: The Apocalypse (2)
paragraphs: Thunder rocked the heavens as golden lightning flashed through the cloud.
If one looked closely, one would see the silhouette of a majestic titan appear in the cloud when the lightning flashed.
Anything the lightning flashed, his silhouette would show, causing many hearts to tremble.
After a few seconds of scaring thousands, what followed next was a spectacle that every warrior on the battlefield had to pause for a moment to witness.
Just when the thunder rocked the clouds for the fifth time, powerful bolts of lightning tore from the clouds and turned thousands of sea beasts to ash.
None of the beasts that the lightning touched survived. Their bodies were burnt by the agonizing fury of the golden lightning.

A voice came, accompanied by an imposing figure who was bathed in golden lightning from head to toe, his fist coated in the same potent golden lightning. He wore no shirt, so his bare-chested physique was on display.
He descended into the battle, blasting thousands of sea beasts away.
Those closer were reduced to nothing, and even those far from him were wounded, some beyond healing.
"Kaizo has arrived."
Kaizo laughed like a lunatic for a few seconds before charging in the direction where Uncle Drake was handling the seven sea kings.
However, just when he was a few meters away, a thick black chain tore through the void and blasted the Manta Ray King away.
"This one is mine." Vaelros appeared, his body wrapped in two thick chains. He was also bare-chested with red line tattoos all over his body.
The attack sent the Manta Ray King flying uncontrollably into the distance, where the moment he landed, his instinct screamed at him to run.
However, he could only think of running. The moment he landed, a red-clawed hand tore through the void and dug hold into his chest.
The hand moved, and that was when Sylara appeared, holding the Manta Ray King’s heart in her clawed hand.
RUMBLE
As if that wasn’t enough, the cloud churned and red lightning flashed through it, revealing a silhouette of a large dragon and a serpent.
The entire battlefield was brought to a standstill as the two creatures appeared with a singular figure standing atop the serpent’s head.
"Ladies and gentlemen, Zareth has arrived."
The moment he spoke, he raised his hand and uttered a single word: "Rain."

The clouds churned even more vigorously than before. Then, from the clouds, thousands of small purple portals opened. From within, thousands of arrows made from an unknown substance started raining down.
Kent’s four original undead appeared, and with them came chaos.
Nobody asked any questions because they knew which side these four people were on.
Kaizo arrived before Uncle Drake, who looked at him for a few seconds and nodded.
"I can handle it from here," Uncle Drake said, and then he transformed into his dragon form. The moment he revealed his dragon form, flames engulfed him, enclosing the six sea kings, including Kaizo.
However, Kaizo merely smiled and then vanished, appearing outside the domain of fire. "So he is the one Master was talking about. He is not too bad."
Sylara appeared beside Kaizo and looked at Uncle Drake, who wasn’t holding back anymore, knowing four powerful allies had arrived.
He could finally unleash a bit more of his strength without any worry.
Kaizo just nodded and then turned to face the thousands of sea beasts still coming out.
"Time to handle the small fries before the main dish arrives."
Though they would prefer fighting thousands of Spirit Ascension stage experts instead of these small fries, they knew this was a war, and one doesn’t choose one’s opponent when in war.
They moved, and in the blink of an eye, they started killing the sea beasts.
The tide of the battle slowly started taking shape.
[30 km away from the battlefield]
Kent’s ladies stood in the air overlooking the battlefield.
"Kaizo sure knows how to make an entrance," Unity said, knowing deep down she wouldn’t be able to beat Kaizo when it came to making an appearance on the battlefield.
"He is called Kaizo for a reason," Vexthra chuckled.
They were in the middle of wrapping up their search in the Unbreakable City (Third floor) when a quest message for Kent appeared.
However, since Kent was still in his enlightened state, the tower forwarded the quest to Vexthra, forcing them to abandon everything and come handle it.
They initially planned on coming out all at once and ending the battle. However, just when they arrived, Vexthra sensed a much darker power slowly breaking free.
The quest confirmed this danger the next second.
Aside from that, Ingrid told her a ship housing powerful people was heading toward the location of the battle.
As a voidling who had improved so much thanks to the training they had in Fedora, she was able to see far into the void and knew the people coming were friendly.
Vexthra then chose to send only the four troublemakers to take control over the battlefield while they waited for whatever was coming to make its appearance.
"They are almost here," Ingrid said, looking into the distance.
Suddenly, the void cracked, and a large ship emerged.
The moment it came out of the void, formations lit up all around as more ships appeared out of thin air, housing thousands of disciples from the supreme immortal sect.
"Kill them all," Lady Enzi, who was leading the charge this time, gave the command, and every last disciple from the Supreme Immortal Sect jumped down and entered the fray.
"They are from the sect," Vexthra commented, looking at disciples quickly gaining control of the battlefield.
Just when every last disciple joined the battlefield, the void cracked, and the sect leader, alongside several elders, appeared on the last ship.
"Princess, time for you to act." Vexthra turned to Princess Lovina, who smiled and vanished.
Far in the distance, Lady Enzi, who was about to charge into battle to protect her disciple, paused and looked to her left.
Princess Lovina appeared, startling everyone.
"Who are you?" Sect Leader Deimos asked. Naturally, sensing her aura, they both knew she was a terrifying opponent, so they raised their guards.
If she were to be an enemy, with their number, they would be able to handle her.
Princess Lovina merely smiled as if knowing what they were thinking, "Kent sent me."
Hearing Kent’s name, they all calmed down.
"Where is he?" Lady Enzi asked, unsure if she should trust this lady. Naturally, she wasn’t the easy-trusting kind.
"Kent has been in close seclusion for the past month."
"Then how did he send you if he wasn’t even aware of this battle?"
Lady Enzi looked at Princess Lovina with a suspicious gaze. However, instead of frowning, Princess Lovina just smiled.
"Kent knew of this battle two years ago and had already made plans for it. Though I have to say he didn’t see the Sea Race joining hands with the Hand to attack.

That said, there are two dangers coming. One is the Ancient Vampire races sealed in the Death Region. They will be free in the next 15 minutes. Aside from them, the Hand has started an inevitable ritual that will open the door to the apocalypse.
Safe to say this world is in danger, so I came to tell you all to be ready; it is going to be a dangerous one."
The faces of everyone turned pale, hearing that there was this much danger looming over them.

Sect Leader Deimos, on the other hand, didn’t seem that alarmed, for he was already aware of the vampires. However, he didn’t expect to hear that the main danger was rather coming from the Hand he had disregarded as a credible threat all these years.
"This battle must end fast." Lady Enzi turned back to the battlefield and was about to charge when Princess Enzi held her back.
"No need," Princess Lovina looked to her left and nodded.
Suddenly, Alina appeared in the air and formed a hand seal.
"Ten Thousand Demon Killing Formation: Activate."

"Kill them all," Lady Enzi, who was leading the charge this time, gave the command, and every last disciple from the Supreme Immortal Sect jumped down and entered the fray.
"They are from the sect," Vexthra commented, looking at disciples quickly gaining control of the battlefield.
Just when every last disciple joined the battlefield, the void cracked, and the sect leader, alongside several elders, appeared on the last ship.
"Princess, time for you to act." Vexthra turned to Princess Lovina, who smiled and vanished.
Far in the distance, Lady Enzi, who was about to charge into battle to protect her disciple, paused and looked to her left.
Princess Lovina appeared, startling everyone.
"Who are you?" Sect Leader Deimos asked.
Naturally, sensing her aura, they both knew she was a terrifying opponent, so they raised their guards.
If she were to be an enemy, with their number, they would be able to handle her.
Princess Lovina merely smiled as if knowing what they were thinking, "Kent sent me."
Hearing Kent’s name, they all calmed down.
"Where is he?" Lady Enzi asked, unsure if she should trust this lady.
Naturally, she wasn’t the easy-trusting kind.
"Kent has been in close seclusion for the past month."
"Then how did he send you if he wasn’t even aware of this battle?"
Lady Enzi looked at Princess Lovina with a suspicious gaze.
However, instead of frowning, Princess Lovina just smiled.
"Kent knew of this battle two years ago and had already made plans for it.
Though I have to say he didn’t see the Sea Race joining hands with the Hand to attack.
That said, there are two dangers coming.
One is the Ancient Vampire races sealed in the Death Region.
They will be free in the next 15 minutes.
Aside from them, the Hand has started an inevitable ritual that will open the door to the apocalypse.
Safe to say this world is in danger, so I came to tell you all to be ready; it is going to be a dangerous one."
The faces of everyone turned pale, hearing that there was this much danger looming over them.
Sect Leader Deimos, on the other hand, didn’t seem that alarmed, for he was already aware of the vampires.
However, he didn’t expect to hear that the main danger was rather coming from the Hand he had disregarded as a credible threat all these years.
"This battle must end fast." Lady Enzi turned back to the battlefield and was about to charge when Princess Enzi held her back.
"No need," Princess Lovina looked to her left and nodded.
Suddenly, Alina appeared in the air and formed a hand seal.
"Ten Thousand Demon Killing Formation: Activate."

chapters.title: Chapter 899: The Apocalypse (3)
paragraphs: Just like how Princess Lovina appeared, Alina came the same way. She appeared out of thin air, and the first thing she did was form a hand seal.
The formation that appeared spread over a large portion of the battlefield. However, it was merely a shell for the main deal.
She then went ahead and activated the main formation using complex hand seals that nobody on the battlefield understood.
It activated, and thousands of smaller killing arrays opened within the larger array, forming a complex formation that immediately locked onto the bodies of the Sea Beasts.
"You brought this on yourself."

With that, four-meter-tall spears coated in thick, potent poison started raining down on the sea beasts. None of the spears missed their targets, so within a few seconds, thousands of sea beasts died, and more kept dying.
Alina remained in the formation, looking like the angel of death as thousands of spears rained down on the sea beasts.
The Ten Thousand Demon Killing Formation was an original masterpiece, which she had been working on during their time in Fedora.
She managed to complete it a few days ago.
This also means, today was the first time using it.
Initially, she wanted to create the ’Battle Matrix,’ which she revealed to Kent after their battle on the third floor.
Naturally, she had started working on that and had even made some progress on it.
However, she put a pin in that and instead chose to create something she could use in a large-scale battlefield that didn’t require her to ask her sisters for help in activating it.
So she created this formation, and now, the sea beasts were at her mercy. However, Alina held no mercy in her eyes.
"Good lord, just what tier is this formation?" Supreme Elder Lance asked, looking at the thousands of beasts dying by the second.
After Lady Enzi killed the last Supreme Elder and his cohort, Elder Lance was made the new Supreme Elder of the outer section of the Supreme Immortal Sect.
"It’s like the more she kills, the stronger the formation becomes," Lady Liora said, unsure how to feel about the killing formation.
Princess Lovina just smiled. "She is an Array/Formation King, so that is a Tier 12 Killing Formation. However, like you said, the formation indeed grows stronger as it kills more people."
"Is that even possible, for a formation to grow stronger?" Lady Enzi asked.

"I am not sure about out there, but in this world, she is the only one who can do that. She is quite brilliant when it comes to formation," Princess Lovina was painting Alina’s image well in the minds of the people watching her display.
To them, there was no way one should be able to activate such a grand formation alone and kill thousands with it while it grows stronger from the kills.
So hearing from someone who actually knew her was, in a way, making them see Alina in a way none of them would forget.
Five minutes into the battle, after hundreds of thousands had died, the Sea Beasts called for a retreat. Thousands immediately abandoned the battlefield and started retreating back into the sea.
"Let them go," Alina’s voice covered the battlefield, halting everyone who was planning to chase after them.
In mere minutes, the surviving beasts dove back into the sea.
Alina deactivated the Ten Thousand Demon Killing Formation and formed another hand seal. This time, a Tier 11 formation opened.
"Superimposing Void Formation."
When the formation opened, it descended into the sea. "Since you retreated, then forever remain in your kingdom until I say otherwise."
Alina coldly spoke as she activated the formation at maximum power.
"She sealed them." Sect Leader Deimos looked stunned, unsure how to handle what had just happened.
"Since when did sealing the void become this easy?" Lady Enzi said, looking at Alina, who was staring back in their direction. With a single movement, she appeared beside Princess Lovina.
"The seal in the Death Region will break in 7 minutes. We should alert everyone," Alina said the moment she arrived.

Sect Leader Deimos clapped his hands, and a powerful force spread everywhere. "Those who can still fight, gather around. Those wounded should be attended to by the healers, for the main battle is on the way."
The sect disciples immediately began flying as they arranged themselves in order. The outer disciples were all in one section, the inner in another section, and the core in their own section.
The various races in Sonox followed the arrangement of the sect. Knowing this was the sect, they all threw away their pride and started listening to orders.
The seven demon states formed one section, with each state forming five lines. The Half-Elves followed up, then the Dragons, Dwarves, the 11 Beast Kingdoms in their own section, then the Elves last.

They had sustained the biggest loss in the just-ended battle. However, they lined up with Lady Aelith, who managed to not only kill that sneaky seahorse but also kill the Sea Dragon standing in front of them. The Elven queen was beside her.
She was tired, but she was not about to look weak—not when the Supreme Immortal Sect was around.
Uncle Drake, Vaelros, Kaizo, Zareth, and Sylara stood on the other side. Uncle Drake was, in a way, happy they were here, for he knew that if they had not arrived, things would have been worse.
Of course, if he were to turn into his dragon form, he would have killed the seven sea kings much faster. However, that would have also affected his team, which he wasn’t ready to do.
In a way, the seven sea kings planned well and executed their move in such a way that he would be caught in the heart of the battle, and their plan worked.
However, he was now free, and thus, he was ready for phase two.
"Don’t worry, Uncle Drake, the main battle is on the way. You will get to kill some vampires," Kaizo said, looking pumped and ready for battle.
Sect Leader Deimos looked at everyone and nodded before he started to speak.

"I know this might come as a shock to you, but information reaching me now is that the seal that has been holding the Ancient Vampire Race is breaking. Four minutes from now, it will break, and the battle will come to us.

Now, I know most of you are already aware of the evil that has been locked in that place. However, to those of you who don’t know, the danger coming has existed for thousands of years before the Battle of Parting.
They survived and now, they are breaking free."
Everybody stiffened when they heard the last words.
They had heard stories of the ancient Battle of Parting and knew it was one that happened several thousand years ago.
However, while they saw what kind of terror it was in the ancient battlefield of Parting, the idea that they would be facing beings from that era was one they weren’t prepared for.
Naturally, the fear could be seen on their faces. Sect Leader Deimos smiled.
"It is not something you all should be worried about. The Supreme Immortal Sect will take the lead. But I can’t guarantee we will be able to do everything.
However, I promise you, with us here, the world won’t come to an end."
Immediately after Sect Leader Deimos ended his words, the clouds started turning red.
"They are here."
Princess Lovina looked toward Vexthra, who nodded at her.
At the same time, a large crack appeared in the air, and the aura of blood and evil began pouring out, causing everyone to turn pale.

chapters.title: Chapter 900: The Apocalypse (4)
paragraphs: "What the hell?" an Earth Dragon warrior muttered, looking at the red crack that appeared in the air.
At once, everyone became pale.
The feeling of dread enveloped everyone, causing them to take a step back. The aura coming from the crack was one they knew was far beyond them.
CRACK
SHATTER
The crack in the air expanded and then shattered, revealing a large red translucent portal. It isn’t transparent, but many can see what’s on the other side.
"Oh my..."
Instinctively, many again took a few steps back when they saw what was on the other side of the cracked space.
Standing on the other side of the crack were thousands of terrifying pale white figures, each with fiery red eyes and dark veins lining their faces.
The majority had clawed hands, with most also holding jagged swords and long, razor-sharp spears that nobody wanted to be at the stabbing end of.
Some even have deadly claws, looking to slash some necks and disfigure some faces.
"Be ready," Sect Leader Deimos said, getting into combat mode.
Suddenly, a figure walked out, bringing with him a rather powerful aura that caused many to take a few steps back again.
Naturally, the strongest on the battlefield moved forward to shield the weaker ones.

"I will only say this once, for the Vampire King wills it. Surrender all those who have Humans, Elven, Qilin, and Dragon bloodlines, and we will leave in peace. Resist, and we will annihilate everyone."
The pressure radiating off the man’s body was pressing down on everyone to the point that even Sect Leader Deimos started turning pale.
However, he stood tall and faced the man.
"This world is for all, so if you can’t live without hurting one another, then naturally, we will exterminate you."

The look in the man’s red eyes intensified when he heard what Sect Leader Deimos said. "Very well. If we can’t come to an agreement, then we will kill everyone here and rule the world instead. After all, you are merely livestock meant to be preyed on."
"We shall see about that," Sect Leader Deimos said, pointing his clawed hand at the vampire.
"Bring it on." Kaizo flew and hovered over everyone, exuding a powerful aura. Thanks to his aura, the pressure coming from the Vampire was blocked to some degree.
The moment the man entered the crack again, everyone felt thousands of auras charging out, causing them to hold their weapons firmly.
"Know that you are fighting to protect your own." With that, Sect Leader Deimos charged forward, meeting the vampires that came out of the crack.
Thousands of warriors on his side also charged forward.
"Ah, what a headache," Lady Enzi sighed, and then she moved. The next second, the sound of glass breaking spread across the battlefield.
It shattered, and a beauty in red leather armor appeared, holding a thin glass sword. Everyone saw this and wondered what was happening.
Lady Liora, who saw this, smiled and said, "Looks like you couldn’t hide anymore and chose to come out." Looking at Lady Enzi bring out her true body made her sigh.

Not even Kent knew that the uptight Lady Enzi he knew and had been interacting with was a mere clone. In fact, aside from Lady Liora, who gave Lady Enzi the Tier 18 Perfect Cloning Pill, nobody knew she was a clone.
However, her main body appeared, and the clone moved and dissolved into her.
BOOM
SHATTERED
The moment her two bodies merged, a powerful aura burst out of her body, turning the vampires charging toward her into glass statues.
Lady Enzi looked angry as she snapped her fingers, and the glass statues shattered instantly. With that, she charged forward and started shattering more vampires as if they were made of glass.
Soon, thousands of vampires were on the battlefield.
"Everyone, stay behind me and Uncle Drake," Queen Jascia commanded as she went into full battle mode, wielding two swords.

The Half-Elves moved behind her and Uncle Drake. Naturally, the elders and the King were in the lead, making sure their warriors were guarded against the tide of vampires that seemed to surpass them in strength.
In fact, the only advantage they had was numbers, so two were ganging up on a vampire — yet even that was proving to be a headache.
"Alina, follow the plan and make sure the pressure isn’t too much on them. Big Sister said we shouldn’t attack just yet," Princess Lovina said, and Alina nodded.
"I will deploy healing arrays for everyone to speed up their healing and another to boost their strength and stamina."
Princess Lovina nodded and continued to observe.
Soon, a three-layered formation — one green, one red, and the last blue — appeared in the air. The moment it was fully activated, every warrior on the battlefield felt energized.
"I like this feeling," Nyss said, evading a spear thrust from a vampire.

She moved back and then disappeared into a shadow. The next second, she appeared behind the vampire and stabbed her dagger. However, the vampire managed to evade by twisting his body in a way that the dagger only grazed his arm.
"Mark." Nyss muttered
While the dagger missed his heart, the graze on his arm was enough for Nyss to do her thing.
"Life Drain."
In an instant, the vampire turned even paler and then dropped dead.
"Wow, what a powerful soul power," Nyss muttered before slipping into the next shadow.
After training tirelessly for the past months, she had used the Innate Talent Awakening Pill Kent gave her to awaken an innate ability tied to her original skill called Mark.
This ability, called ’Mark’, allows her to mark her targets, which she can then use to track them no matter where they go.
However, now, aside from merely marking her targets in order to track them, she had gained an ability that allowed her to take their life force in the form of soul power to strengthen herself.
Provided the target was not two realms above her or had three times her soul strength, she would be able to drain their life force.
So Nyss wasn’t wasting time at all. She was using that powerful innate ability to strengthen herself so she could stay in the battle for a long time.
Naturally, the longer the battle went on, the stronger she would become. Unless, of course, she ran out of stamina — which, thanks to Alina, she wouldn’t be running out of anytime soon.
On one side of the battle, the Pill Princess was doing her best to kill as many vampires as she could, using one flame art after another.
Around her arm, she had three flame runes radiating red, brown, and black colors. Each of these flame runes held a different meaning and ability.
It was a powerful technique her master had given her a few weeks ago.
Whenever she killed a target, all three runes lit up. However, if one looked closely, whenever the three flame runes lit up, her speed, strength, and flame comprehension slightly intensified.
Lady Liora, who was a few meters from her, held a smile on her face as she also had similar runes on her arm.
However, for her, aside from the red, brown, and black flame runes, there were golden and blue flame runes on her left arm and a white flame on her forehead.
"This is your first trial, Sylvara. If you manage to form the next rune on your own, maybe one day, you will be able to rise on your own two feet and roam even immortal worlds without any fear.
Also, with this, I will be able to go back home without any worry." A smile appeared on her face.
Far in the distance, Vexthra, who was paying attention to the battle with her sisters and the legion, raised her brow, looking in Lady Liora’s direction.
’So that is how it is, huh?’
